query: 人工智能6S店, 龙岗区, 深圳

summary.en: Hands-on showroom for Chinese and international AI hardware.
summary.zh: 可动手试用的国内外AI硬件展示店。

why.en: AI devices are shown in real-life settings rather than on shelves, and most can be tried by hand. It pairs with the Robot 6S Store a short drive away in the same robotics block.
why.zh: AI硬件按生活场景展示，不是摆在货架上，大多数可以动手试。和机器人6S店在同一个机器人街区，车程很近。

en: Short drive from the Robot 6S Store

tips.en: Exact address is unconfirmed; the driver should be given the name and checked on the map.
tips.zh: 具体地址待确认，出发前让司机在地图上核对。

query: 动漫星城 公园前 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Underground anime and manga mall at Gongyuanqian Station.
summary.zh: 公园前地铁站下的动漫商场。

why.en: Guangzhou's largest cluster of anime, manga, figure and cosplay shops sits under one roof, directly connected to the metro. Kids can spend hours on figures, gacha machines and character goods.
why.zh: 广州最集中的动漫、手办、cosplay商场，与地铁站直接相连；手办、扭蛋机、角色周边能让孩子逛几个小时。

en: Indoor, good for rain or heat

tips.en: Mobile signal can be weak underground; a meeting point should be agreed. Prices can be negotiated at some stalls.
tips.zh: 地下信号弱，先约好集合点；部分档口可讲价。

reviews.author: James Tan
reviews.text: This place is like a mini Akihabara/Nipponbashi. There's even a Tamashii Nation spot store here that has most of the latest releases . Other shops also sell more or less the latest stuffs.

reviews.author: Lewis Ryu
reviews.text: Just REMEMBER, if there’re any deals like sort of 3 for 2 then those figures or models are probably not genuine. If u’re anime enthusiast or gamer then just head to ‘West Zone‘ have a little walk around u’d find what u need.

reviews.author: Deacon Ho
reviews.text: TLDR: It is a few-story underground mall that has a huge variety of shops and restaurants. Restaurant: Has many varieties, ranging from a sushi restaurant to a steakhouse, and other fast food and convenience stores. Shops: Yes, it has anime shops.

query: Atour Hotel Liwan Lake Lychee Bay Yongqingfang Guangzhou

summary.en: Base for the old-city days, near Lychee Bay and Yongqingfang.
summary.zh: 老城几天的落脚点，靠近荔枝湾和永庆坊。

why.en: Liwan Lake, Lychee Bay, Yongqingfang and Panxi Restaurant are all within a short walk, so the old-city mornings start on foot. Shangxiajiu and Shamian are a ~10–15 min taxi ride away.
why.zh: 荔湾湖、荔枝湾、永庆坊、泮溪酒家都在步行范围内，老城的早上可以直接走出去；上下九、沙面打车约10至15分钟。

en: Walking distance to Yongqingfang and Liwan Lake
Short taxi to Shangxiajiu and Shamian
Atour chain: consistent rooms, laundry room usually available
zh: 步行可到永庆坊、荔湾湖
打车很快到上下九、沙面
亚朵连锁，房间稳定，一般有自助洗衣房

tips.en: The exact branch is unconfirmed; coordinates are approximate. Walking times in the plan assume a location near Lychee Bay and should be rechecked once the address is known.
tips.zh: 具体是哪家分店还未确认，坐标只是大致位置；行程里的步行时间按荔枝湾附近估算，确认地址后要再核对。

query: Avenue of Stars, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong

summary.en: Tsim Sha Tsui harbourfront promenade facing the Central skyline.
summary.zh: 尖沙咀海滨长廊，正对中环天际线。

why.en: The classic view of Hong Kong Island's skyline across Victoria Harbour is seen from here. The Bruce Lee bronze statue links to Bruce Lee's ancestral home visited on Dec 23.
why.zh: 隔着维港看港岛天际线的经典位置。李小龙铜像和23号去过的李小龙祖居连起来。

query: 八合里海记牛肉火锅 南山, 深圳

summary.en: Well-known Chaoshan beef hotpot chain.
summary.zh: 知名潮汕牛肉火锅连锁。

why.en: Fresh beef is cut to order by part, and each cut has a set dipping time in a clear broth. Hand-beaten beef balls are a reliable hit with kids.
why.zh: 鲜牛肉按部位现切，每个部位有固定的涮煮时间，锅底是清汤。手打牛肉丸孩子一般都爱吃。

tips.en: A chain; the branch nearest Shenzhen Bay should be chosen. Exact branch unconfirmed.
tips.zh: 连锁店，选离深圳湾最近的分店；具体分店待确认。

reviews.author: Hugo Chen
reviews.text: The beef tasted pretty good, and the service was decent. The portions weren't large.

reviews.author: 吉田よしだユラ（Ulaa ユラ）
reviews.text: Highly recommended! Delicious and affordable!

query: 百花甜品 文明路 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Old-school tong sui (sweet soup) shop on Wenming Road's dessert street.
summary.zh: 文明路甜品街上的老字号糖水铺。

why.en: Wenming Road is Guangzhou's dessert street, and Baihua is its long-standing anchor. Its sesame and almond pastes are stone-ground and served hot, which is right for a December evening after Beijing Road.
why.zh: 文明路是广州的甜品街，百花是街上的老牌店。芝麻糊、杏仁糊用石磨磨制，热腾腾端上来，十二月逛完北京路吃一碗刚好。

en: Wenming Road's classic tong sui shop

reviews.author: Yingying
reviews.text: Tried their red bean soup - One with barley and the other with sweet potato. I prefer the one with barley even though the sweet potato was also pretty good as well. The serving was generous and staff were also very nice too.

reviews.author: Lionel Ling
reviews.text: Pleasant warm dessert on a cold day. Not too sweet. Total damage is a respectable 31 cny. Nice service by the boss as well thumbs up.

reviews.author: Swee Chye Loh
reviews.text: Ordered a bowl of mixed dessert at a cost of 24 yuan. Food was nice and service was fast. Ordering at be done either at the counter or through scanning of QR via WeChat. There are two levels of seats available.

aliases: 白马服装市场、红棉国际时装城
query: Baima Clothing Market, 16 Zhanqian Road, Yuexiu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Large wholesale clothing market next to Guangzhou Railway Station, with Hongmian International Fashion City beside it.
summary.zh: 广州火车站旁的大型服装批发市场，红棉国际时装城就在旁边。

why.en: Guangzhou is a hub of China's garment trade, and wholesale prices are seen first-hand here. Baima leans mid-to-upper-range women's workwear; next-door Hongmian leans trendy. Many stalls sell single pieces and bargaining is expected.
why.zh: 广州是全国服装贸易中心，这里能直接看到批发价。白马偏中高档通勤女装，旁边的红棉偏潮流款。很多档口一件起卖，可以讲价。

en: Hongmian International Fashion City next door
Single pieces sold at many stalls
zh: 红棉国际时装城就在隔壁

tips.en: Busy on Sunday mornings; backpacks worn on the front. Some stalls are wholesale-only.
tips.zh: 周日上午人多，背包背在前面；部分档口只批发。

reviews.author: Wellington Chamunorwa Muzondo
reviews.text: The latest fashion at excellent quality and awesome prices! You need a lot of time here. Do plan to spend the whole day shopping. The place could do with a few more well priced restaurants.

reviews.author: intan pertiwi
reviews.text: A planet full of quality clothing with wholesale price. Any shoes, bag, accessories, dresses, you can get lost inside and would want to buy everything. You will end up being overweight in your flight back to your country.

reviews.author: TTC_GROUP01 TTC
reviews.text: Wonderful place to visit if you love buying clothes and cases. You can speak Chinese speak English and buy something cheap at this place

query: 宝华面店 宝华路 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Old-style wonton noodle shop on Baohua Road.
summary.zh: 宝华路老牌云吞面店。

why.en: Noodles here are still pressed with a bamboo pole (竹升面), which gives them their springy bite. A bowl is served in minutes, which suits a first meal straight off the plane.
why.zh: 这里仍用竹升压面，面条爽弹有嚼劲；出餐快，落地后第一餐最合适。

en: Shrimp roe lo mein (虾子捞面)

tips.en: Small and busy at peak times; tables are shared.
tips.zh: 店小，高峰期要拼桌。

reviews.author: Dr12b
reviews.text: The must try noodle here is the onion-ginger dry noodles. Portion is large. So you may want to order 1 plate to share so that you can feast on the wanton soup. Portion is also large for the wanton soup.

reviews.author: Jason Tan
reviews.text: The restaurant is famous for it wanton noodle soup. The soup is very flavor, and if you need to do a soup refill, you need to pay extra for it.

aliases: 北京路：大佛寺、逛街、晚餐、甜品
query: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street, Yuexiu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Guangzhou's busiest central shopping street.
summary.zh: 广州最热闹的市中心购物街。

why.en: The commercial heart of the city for over two thousand years, it mixes qilou arcades, malls and brand stores. Lively at night, with heritage food spots on surrounding streets.
why.zh: 两千多年来一直是城市的商业中心，骑楼、商场、品牌店都有；晚上热闹，周边街道有不少老字号美食。

tips.en: Crowded at night; belongings should be watched.
tips.zh: 晚上人多，留意随身物品。

query: 北京路千年古道遗址 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Layers of old road surfaces under glass on Beijing Road.
summary.zh: 北京路玻璃地面下的历代路面。

why.en: Excavations revealed 11 layers of road from the Tang/Song to the Ming and Qing dynasties, now visible under glass panels in the street. Kids can stand on top of a thousand years of the same road.
why.zh: 考古发现从唐宋到明清共11层路面，现在铺上玻璃，站在街上就能看到；小孩可以踩在千年的同一条路上。

tips.en: The layer count is from memory.
tips.zh: 层数凭记忆。

reviews.author: 不想上班卻天天上班的旅人
reviews.text: Beijing Road Pedestrian Street is crowded, but the overall flow is smooth, so you won't get frustrated. Midway through the street, you can see ancient road relics displayed through glass.

reviews.author: Sharu Hakkim
reviews.text: Normally crowded, try to visit during weekdays. It's called , Site of the Millennium Ancient Road on Beijing Road The site of a city street dating back to the seventh centuryIn the summer of 2002, the remains of an ancient street were discovered under…

reviews.author: Yew Kok Teoh
reviews.text: A sampling miniature relics mimicking the ancient China town walkway 1000 years ago.

query: Bruce Lee Ancestral Home, Yongqing 1st Lane, Yongqingfang, Guangzhou

summary.en: Family house of Bruce Lee's father in Yongqingfang.
summary.zh: 永庆坊里李小龙父亲的旧居。

why.en: The house belonged to Lee Hoi-chuen, Bruce Lee's father, a Cantonese opera actor. It now holds photos and memorabilia, a short visit that ties together Cantonese opera and kung fu.
why.zh: 这是李小龙父亲、粤剧演员李海泉的旧居，现展出照片和纪念品；短短一看，把粤剧和功夫连在一起。

reviews.author: daddydrives
reviews.text: We stopped by the Bruce Lee ancestral house while exploring Yongqingfang in Guangzhou. It was an interesting opportunity to learn a little more about his family background and see a different side of someone we mostly associate with kung fu and movies.

reviews.author: Yeo Choon Kuan (Jackson)
reviews.text: This is really an awesome experience to see the life of Bruce Lee unfolded from young till his death. He was definitely a great martial artist well known during his time and even now after he had died so long ago.

reviews.author: L-C
reviews.text: A legend. Now we know a little more about him visiting his ancestral home, and seeing hordes of people on a weekend truly speaks of this legend.

aliases: 广州塔、海心桥、花城广场
query: Canton Tower, 222 Yuejiang West Road, Haizhu, Guangzhou

summary.en: 600 m TV tower with observation decks over the Pearl River.
summary.zh: 600米高的电视塔，可登塔俯瞰珠江。

why.en: At 600 m it is one of the world's tallest towers, and the observation level at over 400 m shows the whole city and river. The tower top adds a Ferris-wheel ride and other thrill attractions, which make it the high point of the trip for most kids.
why.zh: 高600米，世界最高的塔之一；400多米的观光层可以看到全城和珠江；塔顶还有摩天轮等项目，是大多数小孩整趟旅程的高潮。

en: Pearl River and Zhujiang New Town skyline
zh: 珠江和珠江新城天际线

tips.en: Tickets should be bought in advance via official channels. Visibility is poor on overcast days; check the weather first.
tips.zh: 门票提前在官方渠道买；阴天能见度低，出发前看天气。

reviews.author: Husnain Mohammad
reviews.text: The tower is colourful and beautiful. It’s definitely a must visit in Guangzhou. The night view here is great. Come during sunset time and you won’t regret. Do note that this place is quite crowded during weekends and holidays

reviews.author: Colin Leung
reviews.text: Most iconic landmark in Guangzhou.  Must visit, A+ attraction.  Beautiful both during the day and night.  Also costs like $50+ to go up it with several tiers costing more.  Recommend to go early as crowds build up at night.

reviews.author: Alaa Aljanaby
reviews.text: Canton Tower is a must-visit attraction in Guangzhou. It’s an impressive landmark and looks spectacular, especially in the evening when it is fully illuminated.

query: Bubble Tram, Canton Tower, Guangzhou

summary.en: Horizontal Ferris wheel circling the top of Canton Tower.
summary.zh: 绕塔顶一圈的横向摩天轮。

why.en: Transparent capsules travel slowly around the tower's rim at about 450 m, billed as the world's highest Ferris wheel. A full lap gives a 360° view of Guangzhou.
why.zh: 透明车厢在约450米高处沿塔顶边缘慢慢绕一圈，号称世界最高摩天轮，一圈看尽广州360°。

tips.en: Separate ticket required; queue length varies on the day.
tips.zh: 需另外买票，排队时间以现场为准。

query: Cantonese Opera Art Museum, 127 Enning Road, Guangzhou

summary.en: Garden-style museum of Cantonese opera on Enning Road.
summary.zh: 恩宁路上园林式的粤剧博物馆。

why.en: Built in Lingnan garden style with ponds, covered walkways and a stage, it shows costumes, masks and instruments of a UNESCO-listed art form. Free entry, and the garden alone is worth a short stop.
why.zh: 岭南园林式建筑，有池塘、回廊和戏台，展出粤剧（联合国非遗）的戏服、脸谱、乐器；免费入场，园林本身就值得看。

tips.en: Closed Mondays. Free entry is from memory; booking may be required.
tips.zh: 周一闭馆；免费入场凭记忆，可能需要预约。

reviews.author: Eric L
reviews.text: This museum is dedicated to Cantonese opera, and it does a wonderful job showcasing this important part of Guangdong’s cultural heritage.

reviews.author: Luca Pozzi
reviews.text: It is a stunning hidden gem in Guangzhou that beautifully pairs a world-class exhibition of cultural heritage with breathtaking, authentic Lingnan-style water gardens.

query: Capital Cafe 華星冰室 6 Heard Street Wan Chai Hong Kong

summary.en: Popular Hong Kong ice café known for milk tea and scrambled-egg toast.
summary.zh: 香港人气冰室，奶茶和炒蛋多士出名。

why.en: Capital Café is one of Hong Kong’s best-known cha chaan teng-style ice cafés. Silky milk tea is served with fluffy scrambled-egg toast or a crispy condensed-milk bun, the classic afternoon break. It fits the Wan Chai stop on the way back to West Kowloon.
why.zh: 華星冰室是香港最有名的冰室之一。滑奶茶配嫩滑炒蛋多士或脆皮奶油猪仔包，是经典下午茶。正好在回西九龙前的湾仔站。

en: Crispy condensed-milk bun (脆皮奶油猪仔包)

tips.en: Queues are moderate to long; shared tables are normal. Hours are roughly 07:00–21:00/22:00.
tips.zh: 排队中到长，拼桌很正常。营业时间约07:00–21:00/22:00。

name.en: Cha Li Yi Shi (Mall of the World)

query: 茶理宜世 花城汇中区负1层 天河区 广州

summary.en: Guangzhou-born Chinese-style milk tea, inside Mall of the World.
summary.zh: 广州本土国风奶茶，在花城汇里面。

why.en: Cha Li Yi Shi is a Guangzhou brand known for tea-forward, Chinese-style milk teas with floral notes. It sits in the same mall as the dessert stop, so a drink is added without any detour.
why.zh: 茶理宜世是广州本土品牌，奶茶茶味重、带花香，国风设计。就在甜品同一个商场，不用绕路。

en: Yu Yu You Lan (郁郁幽兰)

aliases: 茶理宜世（天河南一路店）

name.en: Cha Li Yi Shi (Tianhe South Road 1)
name.zh: 茶理宜世（天河南一路店）

query: 茶理宜世 天河南一路92号 天河区 广州

summary.en: Guangzhou-born Chinese-style milk tea, between K Hotel and Grandview.
summary.zh: 广州本土国风奶茶，在 K Hotel 和正佳之间。

why.en: Cha Li Yi Shi is the milk-tea pick on Tianhe South Road 1, the street the walk to Grandview passes through. Its teas are tea-forward with floral notes.
why.zh: 茶理宜世是天河南一路上的奶茶选择，去正佳的路上经过。茶味重、带花香。

en: Yu Yu You Lan (郁郁幽兰)

query: Changshou Lu Station, Guangzhou Metro Line 1

summary.en: Line 1 station closest to Shangxiajiu and the Liwan hotel.
summary.zh: 离上下九和荔湾酒店最近的1号线站。

why.en: The nearest metro stop to Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street and the old Xiguan area. Three stops from Gongyuanqian on Line 1.
why.zh: 离上下九步行街和西关老城最近的地铁站，坐1号线到公园前只需3站。

en: 5–10 min walk to the pedestrian street

tips.en: Look for the exit signed “上下九步行街” before leaving the station.
tips.zh: 出站前看准写着“上下九步行街”的出口。

reviews.author: Sơn Ca Nguyễn
reviews.text: Gate A doesn't have an elevator, so going up is a bit tiring. It's about 500 meters from Gate A to Shangxiajiu Street. The goods here are relatively cheap, much cheaper than buying them on Beijing's pedestrian streets.

reviews.author: Jenny Cecilia Prado Viteri
reviews.text: A typical city shopping destination, it's close to many restaurants, individual shops, and shopping centers.

reviews.author: Iyan
reviews.text: Nice , clean and spacious MRT station for famous tourist destination

query: 潮小栈 星河WORLD COCO Park, 坂田, 深圳

summary.en: Casual Chaoshan food: rice noodles, beef balls.
summary.zh: 潮汕小吃：粿条、牛肉丸。

why.en: Chaoshan beef balls are hand-beaten until springy, and kway teow soup is light enough for children. At ~35 yuan per person, it is the quickest and cheapest option in the mall.
why.zh: 潮汕牛肉丸手打，弹牙；粿条汤清淡，孩子也能吃。人均约35元，是商场里最快最省的选择。

en: Beef ball kway teow (牛肉丸粿条)

tips.en: Name comes from older listings; presence in the mall is unconfirmed.
tips.zh: 店名来自较早的资料，是否仍在营业待确认。

query: 陈添记 宝华路十五甫三巷 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Alley shop on Baohua Road, famous for crunchy fish skin since the 1940s.
summary.zh: 宝华路巷子里的老店，以爽鱼皮出名。

why.en: Chen Tim Kee is one of Xiguan’s classic old brands. Its fish skin is blanched, chilled and tossed with peanuts, sesame, coriander and ginger, so it is crunchy rather than fishy. A bowl of sampan congee (艇仔粥) is ordered on the side. It is a few minutes’ walk from Shangxiajiu, so it fits the Dec 21 evening walk.
why.zh: 陈添记是西关的经典老字号。鱼皮焯水后过冷，拌花生、芝麻、香菜和姜丝，爽脆不腥；再配一碗艇仔粥。离上下九只要步行几分钟，正好放在21号晚上的路线里。

en: Xiguan old brand, on the Guangzhou old-brand lists
Crunchy fish skin is the signature

tips.en: Small shop; seating is limited at peak times.
tips.zh: 店面小，饭点座位紧张。

reviews.author: Google reviewer
reviews.text: 陈添记 is tucked into an old house with the entrance down a side alley - rustic and atmospheric. It’s a cool way to experience traditional food in a setting that feels untouched by time.

reviews.author: Google reviewer
reviews.text: This is an old and famous shop serving blanched fish skin in soy marinate and cilantro as its best known speciality. There is also congee, rice rolls, pig trotter and an interesting selection of drinks as well.

reviews.author: Google reviewer
reviews.text: Great place for a feed. It is close to the pedestrian shopping zone. Simple menu, meal for 2 shall involve 2 bowls of congee, 1 rice noodle roll and 1 fish skin. It shall be a good combination!

query: Asian Elephant, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Elephant enclosure where bananas can be bought and fed by hand.
summary.zh: 可以买香蕉亲手喂大象的展区。

why.en: An elephant's trunk takes the banana from your hand, an encounter most kids remember for years. Feeding is done from a raised platform.
why.zh: 大象用鼻子从手里卷走香蕉，孩子会记很多年。在高台上投喂，安全。

tips.en: Feed price is set on site.
tips.zh: 投喂食物价格以现场为准。

query: Coconut Grove Restaurant, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Sit-down restaurant inside Chimelong Paradise, on the official route.
summary.zh: 欢乐世界内的餐厅，官方路线推荐。

why.en: A seated meal in the park where both groups regroup; recommended on Chimelong's official route.
why.zh: 园内能坐下吃饭、两组会合的地方，长隆官方路线推荐。

tips.en: Menu not verified; arrive by 11:30.
tips.zh: 菜单未核实；11:30前到。

query: Dive Coaster, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: B&M dive coaster with a 90° vertical drop.
summary.zh: B&M垂直过山车，90度垂直俯冲。

why.en: The train is held at the edge before a 90° drop, the park's signature thrill and one of the first dive coasters in China (opened 2006).
why.zh: 车厢在顶端悬停后90度垂直俯冲，是园区的招牌项目，也是国内最早的垂直过山车之一（2006年开放）。

tips.en: Loose items go in a locker.
tips.zh: 随身物品放储物柜。

query: Chimelong Tourist Resort, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Evening drone light show at the resort (dates to be confirmed).
summary.zh: 度假区夜间无人机灯光表演（日期待确认）。

why.en: Hundreds of drones form shapes over the resort after dark; it is free to watch for hotel guests and ends the day without more walking.
why.zh: 几百架无人机在度假区夜空组成图案；住客免费观看，不用再走远路。

tips.en: Dates, time, location and whether it is free are unconfirmed; they should be checked with reception or the Chimelong app.
tips.zh: 日期、时间、地点和是否免费均未确认，以前台或长隆APP为准。

query: Flamingo Lake, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Lake with a large flamingo flock near the exit, beside the gift shops.
summary.zh: 出口附近的火烈鸟湖，旁边是纪念品店。

why.en: Hundreds of pink flamingos make the last photo of the day. Souvenir shops are on the way out.
why.zh: 几百只粉色火烈鸟，是当天最后一张照片；出园路上就有纪念品店。

imageCredit: Wikimedia Commons, Xiquinho Silva, CC BY 2.0

query: Chimelong Food Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: À la carte food court in the Chimelong resort.
summary.zh: 长隆度假区内的单点美食区。

why.en: Shorter queues than the hotel buffets, with a choice of Cantonese and fast-food stalls so each person picks their own.
why.zh: 比酒店自助餐少排队，有粤菜和快餐档口，各人点自己想吃的。

tips.en: Exact location within the resort is not verified; it should be confirmed at reception.
tips.zh: 在度假区内的具体位置未核实，以前台说明为准。

query: Giraffe Plaza, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Raised deck for feeding giraffes at head height.
summary.zh: 高台上与长颈鹿平视投喂。

why.en: Giraffes are met eye to eye and fed leaves by hand, the park's most popular activity. The herd is one of the largest in China.
why.zh: 和长颈鹿面对面、亲手喂树叶，是全园最受欢迎的项目；这里的长颈鹿群是国内最大的之一。

tips.en: Queues are long; one adult can queue while the others rest. Feed is sold separately.
tips.zh: 排队长，可以一人排队其他人休息；食物另外买。

query: Happy Theatre, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Seated indoor magic show with audience interaction.
summary.zh: 有观众互动的室内魔术表演。

why.en: An indoor, seated break after a morning of rides, with children often called on stage.
why.zh: 玩了一上午后坐下休息，孩子常被请上台互动。

tips.en: Times per the Chimelong app; official guides mention ~14:00 and 16:30.
tips.zh: 场次以长隆APP为准，官方攻略提过约14:00和16:30。

name.zh: 长隆酒店白虎自助餐厅

query: White Tiger Buffet Restaurant, Chimelong Hotel, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Buffet beside the Chimelong Hotel's white tiger enclosure.
summary.zh: 长隆酒店内、紧邻白虎栖息地的自助餐厅。

why.en: White tigers are watched through the glass while eating, which turns a meal into a sight. The spread is wide: Cantonese roasts, seafood, desserts.
why.zh: 隔着玻璃边吃边看白虎，一顿饭也是一个景点。菜式丰富，有烧味、海鲜、甜品。

en: White tigers visible from the tables
Short shuttle ride from the Panda Hotel
zh: 从熊猫酒店坐接驳车很近

tips.en: In the Chimelong Hotel, not the Panda Hotel. Booking ahead is advised; price and tiger viewing times are not confirmed.
tips.zh: 在长隆酒店，不在熊猫酒店；建议提前订位，价格和看白虎的时段未确认。

reviews.author: Edwin Fong
reviews.text: Many varieties, delicious

reviews.author: C C
reviews.text: I had dinner and breakfast in the restaurant. I purchased the meal coupons from taobao, which is cheaper than the published price. Kids enjoyed watching the two (?) white tigers and flamingoes from the restaurant windows.

reviews.author: Keith Huang (MrKeithHuang)
reviews.text: Restaurant gets extremely busy at breakfast, and the food quality is average at best. In terms of food for the same price, I would try somewhere nearby if you are willing to spend 10 minutes getting there.

aliases: 大马戏剧场、欢乐世界北门
query: Chimelong International Circus, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: ~80 min circus with animals and aerial acrobatics, next to Chimelong Paradise North Gate.
summary.zh: 约80分钟的大型马戏，有动物和高空杂技，在欢乐世界北门旁。

why.en: Performers from many countries in a theatre for several thousand people, with animal acts, motorbike globes and aerial work. Scale and effects are well beyond a typical circus.
why.zh: 来自多个国家的演员，几千人的剧场，有动物表演、摩托车飞球和高空节目，规模和效果远超一般马戏。

en: Huge theatre, strong lighting and sound
Next to the Panda Hotel shuttle
zh: 熊猫酒店坐接驳车就到

tips.en: Doors 17:00; standard seats unassigned, so arrive 45+ min early on holidays. Original booking ID is checked. Not recommended for under-3s or children under 1 m.
tips.zh: 17:00开放入场，普通座不对号，节假日至少提前45分钟；验证购票证件原件；未满3岁或1米以下儿童不建议入场。

reviews.author: JJ Ng
reviews.text: An amazing experience for everyone. The stunts carried out by all the performers were exceptional! It can get rather crowded during weekends so best get a weekday ticket.

reviews.author: Friendly Notary
reviews.text: This circus is so awesome!! It is probably one of the best circus shows I have ever seen. The performers are highly skilled and entertaining. Your kids will love it! You can sit almost anywhere in the arena and still have a great view.

query: Koala Park, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: One of the largest koala groups outside Australia.
summary.zh: 澳洲以外规模最大的考拉种群之一。

why.en: Koalas are rarely seen outside Australia; dozens live here. They sleep most of the day, so a morning visit gives the best chance of movement.
why.zh: 澳洲以外很少能看到考拉，这里有几十只。它们大部分时间在睡，上午最有机会看到动。

aliases: 熊猫酒店最后一个上午
query: Chimelong Panda Hotel, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Panda-themed resort hotel next to Chimelong Safari Park and Chimelong Paradise.
summary.zh: 紧邻长隆野生动物世界和欢乐世界的熊猫主题度假酒店。

why.en: Guests may enter Safari Park 30 minutes before general visitors via the North Gate, which is when queues for the safari train are shortest. Free shuttles run to every park, so no taxis are needed for three days. Lobby, corridors and rooms are panda-themed throughout.
why.zh: 住客可比一般游客提前半小时从北门进入野生动物世界，小火车排队最短就在这段时间。免费接驳车通往各个园区，三天不用打车。大堂、走廊和客房全是熊猫主题。

en: Early Safari Park entry for guests (North Gate)
Free shuttles from 2F to each park
Panda décor and kids' area for photos
zh: 二楼坐免费接驳车去各园区
熊猫装饰和儿童区，适合拍照

tips.en: Check-in from 15:00, checkout by 12:00. Shuttle departure point (2F) should be confirmed at reception.
tips.zh: 15:00后入住，12:00前退房。接驳车上车点（二楼）以前台说明为准。

query: Panda Paradise, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Giant panda enclosures, home of the Chimelong panda triplets.
summary.zh: 大熊猫馆，长隆熊猫三胞胎的家。

why.en: Pandas are most active in the morning, eating bamboo and climbing. The triplets Mengmeng, Shuaishuai and Kuku were born here in 2014.
why.zh: 熊猫上午最活跃，吃竹子、爬树。萌萌、帅帅、酷酷三胞胎2014年在这里出生。

tips.en: Visit before 11:00 for active pandas.
tips.zh: 11点前去，熊猫最活跃。

query: Chimelong Paradise, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Theme park with major roller coasters and a large kids' area.
summary.zh: 有多台大型过山车和大面积儿童区的主题乐园。

why.en: Thrill seekers get world-class coasters, including a vertical dive coaster and a ten-inversion coaster, while younger kids have a separate gentle-ride zone, so the family splits and meets for lunch.
why.zh: 喜欢刺激的有垂直过山车、十环过山车等大型项目；小朋友有专门的温和项目区，两组分开玩，中午会合。

tips.en: Queues are shortest in the first two hours. Water rides are best skipped in December.
tips.zh: 开园头两小时排队最短；12月天冷，湿身项目建议跳过。

reviews.author: Cola Bank
reviews.text: Yet another great theme park. They shut down their old 10 loop coaster( it was really rough when I went last time) and replaced it with a really good launch coaster. The acceleration, windiness and ride was just butter smooth and I loved it.

reviews.author: NOOR MOHAMMAD
reviews.text: Chimelong Paradise is one of the most exciting and well-maintained amusement parks in China, located in Guangzhou. The park offers a wide variety of thrilling rides, including world-class roller coasters that are perfect for adrenaline lovers.

reviews.author: ZhanYuan
reviews.text: Getting here is pretty easy. When exit the metro station, there will be many different people that want to sell ponchos and delivery service to the theme park or resort. Booking tickets in advance will be better because counter was quite slow.

query: Scream Zone, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: High-speed launched coaster just inside the North Gate.
summary.zh: 北门进去就到的高速弹射过山车。

why.en: One of the park's most popular rides; done at opening, the queue is a fraction of the afternoon wait.
why.zh: 全园最热门的项目之一，开园就去，排队只是下午的零头。

tips.en: Official English name and height limit are not verified; check signage.
tips.zh: 官方英文名和身高限制未核实，以现场标示为准。

name.zh: 长隆野生动物世界空中缆车

query: Cable car, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: ~30 min loop over the park.
summary.zh: 约30分钟环园缆车。

why.en: The whole park, including the animal plains, is seen from above while seated, which doubles as an afternoon rest.
why.zh: 坐着从高处看全园和放养区，也是下午的休息时间。

name.zh: 长隆野生动物世界熊猫餐厅

query: Panda Restaurant, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: In-park themed restaurant serving panda-shaped dishes.
summary.zh: 园内主题餐厅，熊猫造型餐点。

why.en: Rice, buns and desserts are shaped like pandas, which keeps kids eating on a long park day. Seating indoors gives a proper rest at midday.
why.zh: 饭团、包子、甜点都做成熊猫造型，孩子在园里走了半天也愿意吃。室内有座位，中午能好好休息。

en: Panda rice set (熊猫饭团套餐)

tips.en: Exact menu and location within the park are not verified; arrive by 11:45 to beat the rush.
tips.zh: 具体菜单和园内位置未核实；11:45前到，避开人潮。

query: Chimelong Safari Park, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: China's largest safari park: pandas, koalas, white tigers, a safari train and cable car.
summary.zh: 国内规模最大的野生动物园之一：熊猫、考拉、白虎、小火车和缆车。

why.en: Giant pandas, including the world's only surviving panda triplets born here in 2014, are seen up close. Elephants and giraffes are fed by hand, and the safari train passes free-roaming herds. A full day is filled for every age.
why.zh: 可以近距离看大熊猫，包括2014年在这里出生、全球唯一存活的熊猫三胞胎。可以亲手喂大象和长颈鹿，小火车穿过放养的动物群。各年龄段都能玩满一天。

en: Cable car over the whole park
zh: 熊猫乐园看熊猫三胞胎

tips.en: Panda Hotel guests enter 30 min early via the North Gate. Queue times are shown in the official Chimelong app.
tips.zh: 熊猫酒店住客可从北门提前半小时入园；长隆官方APP有各馆排队时间。

reviews.author: Keith Huang (MrKeithHuang)
reviews.text: A great full-day outing with young children, but plan your route carefully—it is huge and involves a lot of walking.

reviews.author: Matthias
reviews.text: It's a good idea to rent a driver and car. You are much closer at most locations than the train and you do not have to wait. For me and my children the safari was the best zoo experience ever.

reviews.author: alex chu
reviews.text: A nice, world class zoo located not far from where the Canton Expo is held. It’s easy to trek inside the zoo with lots of direction arrows pointing to zoo highlights, ie the Chinese panda, koalas, white tigers, etc.

name.zh: 长隆野生动物世界小火车

query: Chimelong Safari Park train station, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: ~35 min seated loop through the big-cat, giraffe and zebra areas.
summary.zh: 约35分钟坐着绕园，经过猛兽区、长颈鹿和斑马。

why.en: The open plains, where animals roam rather than sit in pens, are only reached this way. Queues pass 1 hour by mid-morning, so it is done first.
why.zh: 动物放养的大片区域只能坐小火车进去。上午晚些排队超过1小时，所以第一个去。

en: Lions, tigers and bears from the train

tips.en: Go straight to the station at entry.
tips.zh: 入园后直奔小火车站。

query: Star Dream Garden, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Family ride zone with carousel and bouncing rides.
summary.zh: 亲子项目区，有转马和跳跳类项目。

why.en: Gentle rides grouped close together, so younger children ride many times with little walking or queuing.
why.zh: 温和项目集中在一起，小朋友少走路、少排队，可以玩很多次。

tips.en: Ride list per the 2026 official map; English name is a translation.
tips.zh: 项目以官方地图为准；英文名为意译。

imageCredit: Brand photo (chimelong.com, Dream Carousel in this zone)

query: Super pendulum, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Giant swinging pendulum with full 360° rotation.
summary.zh: 可360度翻转的巨型摆锤。

why.en: Swings past horizontal and turns riders fully upside down; short queue compared with the coasters.
why.zh: 摆过水平线、整圈倒转，排队通常比过山车短。

tips.en: Phones and wallets go in a locker first.
tips.zh: 手机钱包先放储物柜。

query: Tornado ride, Chimelong Paradise, Guangzhou

summary.en: Spinning thrill ride in the Scream Zone.
summary.zh: 尖叫地带的旋转刺激项目。

why.en: Right next to the Rocket Coaster, so it is ridden straight after with no walking.
why.zh: 就在火箭过山车旁边，玩完直接排，不用走路。

tips.en: Ride type and restrictions are not verified.
tips.zh: 项目类型和限制未核实。

query: White Tiger, Chimelong Safari Park, Guangzhou

summary.en: Enclosure for Chimelong's large white Bengal tiger group.
summary.zh: 长隆白虎（白色孟加拉虎）展区。

why.en: Chimelong keeps one of the world's largest groups of white tigers. They are seen at close range through glass.
why.zh: 长隆有全球数量最多的白虎群之一，隔着玻璃近距离看。

imageCredit: Wikimedia Commons, Xiquinho Silva, CC BY 2.0

query: 中国调味文化馆 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Small museum on the history of Foshan soy sauce and condiments.
summary.zh: 讲佛山酱油和调味品历史的小型展馆。

why.en: Haday, China's best-known soy sauce brand, comes from Foshan, and the traditional sun-brewing process is shown here. A quick loop gives kids a link between the food they eat and where it comes from.
why.zh: 中国最知名的酱油品牌海天就出自佛山，这里展示传统晒制酱油的工艺。快快看一圈，孩子能把吃到的东西和来源联系起来。

tips.en: Opening hours and exact location unconfirmed.
tips.zh: 开放时间和具体位置未核实。

query: Dafo Temple, Huifu East Road, Yuexiu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Large Buddhist temple just off Beijing Road.
summary.zh: 北京路旁的大型佛寺。

why.en: Dating back over a thousand years, the main hall holds three giant bronze Buddhas cast in the Qing dynasty. It is lit at dusk and sits a few minutes from the Beijing Road pedestrian street.
why.zh: 历史上千年，大殿供奉三尊清代铸造的大铜佛；傍晚亮灯，离北京路步行街几分钟。

tips.en: May be closed by early evening; photos at the gate are an option.
tips.zh: 傍晚可能已关门，可在门口拍照。

reviews.author: Jo Lee
reviews.text: This temple has over a thousand years of history and remains an important Buddhist site in Guangzhou today. You can walk right out of a modern shopping mall and find this large traditional wooden structure right in front of you.

reviews.author: Jean Paul Lucat
reviews.text: The Dafo Temple (大佛寺), or “Temple of the Great Buddha,” is a centuries-old Buddhist sanctuary that provides a peaceful retreat amid the bustling city.

query: 点都德 天河区, 广州

summary.en: Popular Guangzhou dim sum chain; nearest Tianhe branch.
summary.zh: 广州人气早茶连锁，选最近的天河分店。

why.en: A reliable introduction to Guangzhou morning tea: dim sum is made to order and ordered by QR code, so no Cantonese is needed. The pink golden-shrimp rice roll is the signature that put the chain on the map.
why.zh: 体验广州早茶的稳妥之选：点心现点现做，扫码点餐，不会粤语也没问题。粉红色的金莎红米肠是让它出名的招牌。

en: Golden crispy shrimp red rice roll
Golden crispy shrimp red rice roll (金莎红米肠)
Honey char siu bao (蜜汁叉烧包)
Caramel iced tofu pudding (焦糖冰豆花)

tips.en: Search “点都德” in Amap for the nearest Tianhe branch; exact branch and coordinates are unconfirmed. Calling ahead about reservations can save queuing.
tips.zh: 在高德搜“点都德”选最近的天河分店；具体分店和坐标待确认。可以先打电话问能否订位。

reviews.author: Aileen Chin
reviews.text: Authentic dim sum restaurant with a spacious and clean dining environment. The food was fresh, well-prepared, and overall very enjoyable. Service was comfortable and unhurried, so there was no rush to leave after the meal.

reviews.author: Tulaya Khangtatswas
reviews.text: So delicious and price is surprisingly affordable compared to quality. Staff are lovely and well-trained. This is another reason for me to visit Guangzhou.

reviews.author: 김기천
reviews.text: The meal begins with warm tea. In addition to dim sum, the noodles and rice are also delicious. It is a restaurant with a long tradition.

query: 恩宁雪糕行 恩宁路69号 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Ice cream in Cantonese flavours at 69 Enning Road.
summary.zh: 恩宁路69号的广式口味雪糕。

why.en: Flavours are taken from local food: chicken biscuit (鸡仔饼), ginger milk curd, Phoenix Dancong tea and milk tea. Next door, Enning Gongfei serves “檬茶茶”, black tea with dried plum and lemon.
why.zh: 口味来自本地食物：鸡仔饼、姜撞奶、凤凰单枞、奶茶；旁边的恩宁公啡有“檬茶茶”，红茶加话梅和柠檬。

en: On the walk to Tao Tao Ju
Chicken biscuit ice cream (鸡仔饼雪糕)
Ginger milk curd ice cream (姜撞奶雪糕)

query: Enning Road, Liwan, Guangzhou

summary.en: Curving street of old qilou arcades.
summary.zh: 弯弯的老骑楼街。

why.en: Often called the most beautiful qilou street in Guangzhou for its unbroken curve of arcades. It connects Yongqingfang to Dishifu Road, so it is walked on the way to lunch.
why.zh: 骑楼连成一道弯，常被称为广州最美的骑楼街；连接永庆坊和第十甫路，去午餐顺路走过。

query: Fashion Tianhe, Tianhe Sports Center, Guangzhou

summary.en: Underground mall beneath Tianhe Sports Center for anime, collectible toys and budget fashion.
summary.zh: 天河体育中心地下商场，动漫、潮玩和平价服饰集中。

why.en: Anime merchandise, blind boxes and designer toys are concentrated in one underground mall, at lower prices than the big malls above.
why.zh: 动漫周边、盲盒和潮玩集中在一个地下商场，价格比楼上大商场低。

tips.en: ~10 min walk from Grandview. Children should be accompanied.
tips.zh: 从正佳步行约10分钟；小孩要有人陪同。

query: 逢源大街 西关大屋 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Street of traditional Xiguan merchant houses.
summary.zh: 保留传统西关大屋的老街。

why.en: Xiguan mansions were the homes of wealthy Qing-era merchants. Their sliding-bar gates (趟栊门) and coloured Manchu windows (满洲窗) are unique to old Guangzhou; kids can try to spot the three-layer door.
why.zh: 西关大屋是清代富商的住宅，趟栊门和满洲窗是老广州独有的；可以让小孩找找三重门。

tips.en: Mostly private homes; view from outside.
tips.zh: 多数是民居，在外面看。

query: Foshan Ancestral Temple, 21 Zumiao Road, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Taoist temple to the god Beidi, first built in the Northern Song dynasty; home to the lion dance show and kung fu memorial halls.
summary.zh: 供奉北帝的道观，始建于北宋；醒狮表演和武术纪念馆都在里面。

why.en: Its ridges are covered in coloured Shiwan ceramic figures — some of the finest Lingnan decorative art anywhere. The daily lion dance and kung fu show, the Wong Fei-hung and Ip Man halls, and a Qing opera stage are all covered by one ticket, so a full morning is spent without moving the car.
why.zh: 屋脊上满是彩色石湾陶塑，是岭南装饰艺术的精品。每天的醒狮武术表演、黄飞鸿和叶问纪念馆、清代古戏台都在一张门票里，一个上午不用挪车。

en: Ceramic ridge figures and wood and brick carvings on the main hall
Daily lion dance and kung fu shows
Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall and Ip Man Hall inside
Wanfu Stage, a Qing-dynasty opera stage
zh: 大殿的陶塑瓦脊、木雕、砖雕
园内有黄飞鸿纪念馆和叶问堂

tips.en: Open 08:30–18:00. Ask at entry whether same-day re-entry is allowed.
tips.zh: 开放时间08:30–18:00；入园时问清楚当天能否再进。

reviews.author: KT Lim
reviews.text: Must visit Temple of Emperor HuangDi . Together with Ip Man Museum _ famous Martial Art Grandmaster who coached legendary Hollywood Bruce Lee And watch Wong Fei Hong Troup perform Lion Dance at 10 am in front of his memorial hall/square..

reviews.author: winnie leong
reviews.text: Today was an absolute vibe at the iconic Foshan Ancestral Temple (Zumiao) in the heart of Chancheng District, Foshan (Address: 21 Zumiao Road, Chancheng, Foshan; opening hours: 8:30am–6:00pm).

name.en: Lion Dance and Kung Fu Show, Foshan Ancestral Temple

query: Foshan Ancestral Temple, 21 Zumiao Road, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Daily southern lion dance and kung fu performance inside the temple grounds.
summary.zh: 祖庙内每天上演的南狮和武术表演。

why.en: Foshan is the home of the southern lion dance, and this show is performed in the town where Wong Fei-hung's lineage was rooted. Lions climb poles and leap between stands while drums play; kids are usually spellbound.
why.zh: 佛山是南狮的发源地，也是黄飞鸿武术流派扎根的地方。狮子在鼓声中上桩、跳跃，孩子通常看得目不转睛。

en: Kung fu forms by local troupes

tips.en: Arrive 15 min early for front spots. Suspended in rain; times and venue per the temple notice on the day.
tips.zh: 提前15分钟到占前排；雨天暂停，时间和场地以当天公告为准。

name.zh: From·K Hotel 体育西路地铁站店

query: From K Hotel Tiyu Xilu Metro Station, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: Tianhe base by Tiyu Xilu metro, ~10 min walk to Grandview Mall.
summary.zh: 天河体育西路地铁站旁，步行约10分钟到正佳广场。

why.en: Tiyu Xilu is an interchange of Metro Lines 1 and 3, so most of the city is one ride away. Grandview, Teemall, Parc Central and Fashion Tianhe are all within a 10-minute walk.
why.zh: 体育西路是地铁1号线和3号线换乘站，去市内大部分地方一程可达。正佳、天河城、天环广场和时尚天河都在步行10分钟内。

en: Metro Lines 1 and 3 at the door
Walking distance to Tianhe's main malls
zh: 门口就是地铁1号线、3号线
步行可到天河主要商场

tips.en: Navigate to “From K Hotel 体育西路”. Exact entrance and branch should be confirmed on Amap (高德).
tips.zh: 导航“From K Hotel 体育西路”；具体入口和门店以高德为准。

query: 星河WORLD COCO Park, 坂田, 龙岗区, 深圳

summary.en: Mall in the same Galaxy WORLD campus as the Robot 6S Store.
summary.zh: 与机器人6S店同在星河WORLD园区的商场。

why.en: Lunch is reached on foot from the Robot 6S Store, so no extra ride is needed. Chain restaurants are concentrated here, which makes it easy to find something for both adults and kids.
why.zh: 从机器人6S店步行就到，不用再坐车。商场里连锁餐厅集中，大人小孩都容易找到合适的。

en: Walking distance from the Robot 6S Store
Many chain restaurants in one place
Indoor, good for a midday break

tips.en: Restaurant line-up should be checked on the day; older listings may be out of date.
tips.zh: 餐厅以现场为准，较早的资料可能已过时。

reviews.author: Klaus Delueg
reviews.text: Went to Yushan Season mushroom hotpot restaurant (L4C-023A): delicious food, helpful, friendly and fast stuff, nice environment. Definitely worth a try and to come back.

reviews.author: Carol Chung
reviews.text: I stumbled upon this handmade dessert shop, Zhulong Rushui, and they have a huge selection of sweet soups with innovative flavors. The desserts are both beautifully presented and delicious.

query: 公路咖啡 永庆坊 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Café in Yongqingfang known for its claypot latte.
summary.zh: 永庆坊里的咖啡店，以煲仔拿铁出名。

why.en: The latte is served in a Cantonese clay pot (煲仔), a local twist that photographs well. Caffeine-free drinks are available for the kids.
why.zh: 拿铁装在广式砂锅里，很本地也很上镜；小孩可以点不含咖啡的饮品。

tips.en: Shop details are from a 2022 guide and may have changed.
tips.zh: 资料来自2022年攻略，可能已变动。

query: Gongyuanqian Station, Guangzhou Metro

summary.en: Metro interchange for Lines 1 and 2; Animation City is inside.
summary.zh: 地铁1、2号线换乘站，动漫星城就在站内。

why.en: The central interchange of the metro network. Animation City opens directly off the concourse, so no street crossing is needed.
why.zh: 地铁网络的中心换乘站；动漫星城直接连着站厅，不用过马路。

reviews.author: Runsheng He
reviews.text: It's the station that you can walk to the Beijing Road. Parks, museums are all around.

reviews.author: Iyan
reviews.text: Clean station. Well maintained and helpful staff.

reviews.author: Mart B
reviews.text: As a european, i really like the atmosphere, the mix between new and old buildings. And lot's of restaurant's.

query: Grandview Mall, Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: One of Guangzhou's largest malls, with themed floors, an aquarium and a polar museum.
summary.zh: 广州最大的商场之一，楼层各有主题，还有海洋馆和极地展馆。

why.en: Shopping, dining and kids' attractions are combined under one roof: sports brands on 3F, restaurants on 5F–7F, and an indoor aquarium. Ten minutes on foot from the hotel.
why.zh: 购物、吃饭和亲子景点都在一个屋檐下：三楼运动品牌，五至七楼餐厅，还有室内海洋馆。离酒店步行10分钟。

en: Connected to Teemall and Parc Central nearby
zh: 附近有天河城和天环广场

reviews.author: thrddyfmly
reviews.text: This mall has everything for a family. Good variety of restaurants. We came here in summer to escape the heat and it didn’t disappoint. Loved the Pokemon gym. Large and spacious. Also enjoyed the animal experience on 7th floor.

reviews.author: Zahara Zulkifley
reviews.text: This review is meant for Grandview Aquarium specifically. I really wish we hadn't rushed our visit so we could have spent a solid 1 to 2 hours properly enjoying the exhibits.

query: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, Baiyun, Guangzhou

summary.en: Guangzhou's main airport, ~45 min by taxi from Tianhe in early-morning traffic.
summary.zh: 广州主要机场，清晨从天河打车约45分钟。

why.en: International check-in, bag drop and security can take a while, so ~2 hr 45 min is allowed. Breakfast is available airside.
why.zh: 国际航班值机、托运、安检耗时，所以预留约2小时45分钟；可以在机场吃早餐。

tips.en: Terminal depends on the airline; confirm T1, T2 or T3 on the ticket before booking the car.
tips.zh: 航站楼按航空公司而定，叫车前在机票上确认是T1、T2还是T3。

reviews.author: Joana
reviews.text: I had a pleasant experience at Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport. The airport is clean, modern, and well maintained. There are plenty of comfortable chairs throughout the terminals, making it easy to relax while waiting for a flight.

reviews.author: Ismail Faseeh
reviews.text: Had a very positive experience at Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport. The airport is huge, modern, clean, and very well maintained. Despite its size, everything is well organized, with clear signage that makes it relatively easy to navigate.

reviews.author: T3rby
reviews.text: Baiyun Airport’s new terminal opened last October, and the overall look immediately reminded me of some futuristic architecture in the Middle East.

name.en: Chinese restaurant, Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Tianhe
name.zh: 广州正佳万豪酒店中餐厅

query: Guangzhou Marriott Hotel Tianhe Chinese restaurant, Tianhe Road, Guangzhou

summary.en: Hotel Cantonese restaurant beside Grandview Mall.
summary.zh: 正佳广场旁的酒店粤菜餐厅。

why.en: A proper sit-down Cantonese dinner with hotel-level service, a few minutes' walk from the K Hotel.
why.zh: 酒店水准的正式粤菜晚餐，离K Hotel步行几分钟。

tips.en: Restaurant name and menu are not verified; booking ahead is advised.
tips.zh: 餐厅名称和菜单未核实，建议提前订位。

query: 广州酒家 文昌南路2号 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Guangzhou’s best-known Cantonese restaurant brand, founded in 1935.
summary.zh: 1935年创立的广州粤菜代表老字号。

why.en: Guangzhou Restaurant is the name most locals give for “classic Cantonese”. The Wenchang South Road flagship is the original site. Wenchang chicken is served with smooth, yellow skin and ginger-scallion dip, and the dim sum and roast meats are reliable all round. It suits a proper sit-down dinner before the night cruise.
why.zh: 广州酒家是很多本地人心里“正宗粤菜”的代名词，文昌南路是总店原址。文昌鸡皮爽肉滑、配姜葱蓉，点心和烧味都很稳，适合夜游前好好坐下来吃一顿。

tips.en: Queues are long even with a booking (reviews mention 20 min to 2 hr). A table should be booked ahead, and the queue can be tracked via WeChat.
tips.zh: 即使订位也常要等（评价提到20分钟到2小时）。建议提前订位，可用微信看排队进度。

reviews.author: Google reviewer
reviews.text: Food at GZ Restaurant was very good. The roast goose, chicken, sweet and sour pork and dumplings we ordered were all delicious. One of the best meal we had in GZ.

reviews.author: Google reviewer
reviews.text: Full marks for heritage, points deducted for service. We made a reservation in advance but still had to wait about 20 minutes upon arrival. Fortunately, we spent the time exploring the in-house Cantonese cuisine museum.

reviews.author: Google reviewer
reviews.text: Delicious dim sum. I’ve tried 蓮香樓 and 大三元, and this place suits my taste the best. You can track the queue progress via WeChat.

query: 行运楼 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Sit-down Cantonese restaurant inside Lingnan Tiandi.
summary.zh: 岭南天地内可以正式坐下来吃的粤菜馆。

why.en: A proper sit-down meal is offered inside the old quarter, so no car is needed between sights. Cantonese classics suit kids who prefer mild flavours.
why.zh: 就在老街区里，坐下来正式吃一餐，不用再坐车。粤菜口味清淡，适合孩子。

tips.en: Name comes from an older guide; whether it is still open should be checked on the day.
tips.zh: 店名来自较早的攻略，到时确认是否仍在营业。

query: Hong Kong Tramways, Des Voeux Road Central, Hong Kong

summary.en: Double-decker trams across Hong Kong Island since 1904.
summary.zh: 1904年起运营的港岛双层电车。

why.en: One of the few double-decker tram fleets still in service anywhere. The front row of the upper deck gives a slow street-level tour from Central to Wan Chai for a flat fare.
why.zh: 全世界少数仍在运营的双层电车之一。坐上层前排，慢慢看中环到湾仔的街景，车费统一。

tips.en: Board at the back, pay on exit at the front.
tips.zh: 后门上车，前门下车时付款。

reviews.author: Grace Cheung Yin
reviews.text: cheapest transport to enjoy a ride from East to West of Hong Kong Island. Can drop off anywhere you like. The front and back of the upper decks are the best seats for street photography. Many trams, beautiful advertisements on both sides.

reviews.author: Rajan Narayan
reviews.text: Hong Kong is a wonderful, tourist friendly destination. I have enjoyed visiting it every time. One of its unique and most attractive highlights are the trams that ply in parts of it. Oh how lovely are they!

reviews.author: D C
reviews.text: See and learn about Hong Kong on a tram! It’s a great commentary, so interesting! Must do!

query: Hong Kong West Kowloon Station, Kowloon, Hong Kong

summary.en: High-speed rail terminus with joint mainland/Hong Kong border clearance.
summary.zh: 高铁总站，内地与香港在站内一地两检。

why.en: Mainland exit and Hong Kong entry are both handled inside the station, so the border is crossed in one step. Guangzhou South is ~50 min away.
why.zh: 内地出境和香港入境都在站内办完，一次过关。到广州南约50分钟。

en: Taxi ~15 min to Tsim Sha Tsui
zh: 打的士约15分钟到尖沙咀

tips.en: ~30–40 min should be allowed for clearance. Travel documents for Hong Kong entry and mainland return must be carried.
tips.zh: 预留30至40分钟过关。带好入境香港和回内地的证件。

reviews.author: AB!
reviews.text: It's a modern railway terminus serving all high speed trains between Hong Kong and mainland China. Opened in 2018, the station has become a key transportation hub for travel between Hong Kong and mainland.

reviews.author: WaiChin Wong
reviews.text: Took a high speed train from west Kowloon to Shen zhen. It’s about 15mins of travelling in train. Immigration clearance roughly is 1 hour. We came on weekdays at 3pm and our train was 5pm. So better buy ticket at stations to avoid any delay at immigrations.

query: Huacheng Square, Zhujiang New Town, Guangzhou

summary.en: Central-axis plaza in Zhujiang New Town.
summary.zh: 珠江新城的城市中轴广场。

why.en: The long open plaza sits on Guangzhou's new central axis, between the Guangzhou Opera House, the library and the city's tallest towers. Space to run, plus views back to Canton Tower.
why.zh: 位于广州新中轴线上，两边是广州大剧院、图书馆和全城最高的楼；地方大可以跑，还能回看广州塔。

reviews.author: ImmersiveWalk
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning square! The view of the Canton Tower and the surrounding skyscrapers is breathtaking, especially at night. It’s the perfect place for a walk.

reviews.author: Dejan Braki
reviews.text: Huacheng square is the epicenter of modern Guangzhou, located on the opposite side of Canton tower and Pearl river.

reviews.author: Teck Chong Law
reviews.text: This is a nice park on the street level with a huge shopping mall underground.

query: Huagai Road Pedestrian Street, Daliang, Shunde, Foshan

summary.en: Daliang's oldest arcade (qilou) street, lined with old brands, snacks and souvenir shops.
summary.zh: 大良最老的骑楼街，两边是老字号、小吃和手信店。

why.en: Shunde is a UNESCO City of Gastronomy, and its street snacks are sampled here in a short walk. Lunjiao cake, Daliang fried milk and beef offal skewers can be eaten on the go under the arcades.
why.zh: 顺德是联合国教科文组织认定的“美食之都”，这条短街就能尝到街头小吃。伦教糕、大良炒牛奶、牛杂串都可以在骑楼下边走边吃。

reviews.author: Julian Wong
reviews.text: A fairly long walking street in this area. It is not very far from 清晖园, so it is worth a visit if you are in this area. There are a good mix of retails and eateries. The retailing is fairly cheap as compare to those in the big mall.

reviews.author: Moiz Malik
reviews.text: This place is awesome, but unfortunately I came during the raining season, so not so awesome for me. I would've loved to explore more of this place when it's sunny. This is a picturesque area to see; lots of old world charm and the bustling of the present.

reviews.author: Calvin Law
reviews.text: Great place to stay and shop! They literally have everything you need here. And it gets crowded during the day so make sure you go early. Streets are relatively clean.

query: 华林玉器街 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Jade and jewellery market just north of Xiajiu Road.
summary.zh: 下九路北侧的玉器珠宝街。

why.en: One of China's largest jade trading streets, with hundreds of shops and stalls. Raw stones being carved and haggled over make it worth a short look even without buying.
why.zh: 全国规模最大的玉器集散街之一，几百家店铺档口；看人雕玉、讲价，不买也值得走一圈。

tips.en: Quality and pricing vary widely; serious purchases are not recommended without expertise.
tips.zh: 质量和价格差别很大，不懂行不建议大额购买。

reviews.author: Art Chi
reviews.text: Giant Jade Market. Everything you could want to buy, from a ring to statues and large figurines. Prices according to the quality you want, for all tastes and budgets.

reviews.author: Leon Hon
reviews.text: It is a place view jadeite... just be aware that if you are a foreigner... they might charge overpriced.

query: Hualin Temple, Liwan, Guangzhou

summary.en: Buddhist temple traditionally linked to Bodhidharma's landing in Guangzhou.
summary.zh: 相传与达摩来广州登岸有关的佛寺。

why.en: Tradition holds that the temple stands where Bodhidharma first preached after arriving in China around 527 AD. Its Hall of 500 Arhats has rows of individual statues, which children can study for different faces and poses. It sits beside the jade street, so both are seen in one stop.
why.zh: 相传达摩约公元527年来华后在此最先传法；五百罗汉堂里每尊罗汉表情动作各不相同，小孩可以一尊尊找。和玉器街在一起，一次看完。

tips.en: Opening hours could not be confirmed. Go in if open; otherwise look from the gate.
tips.zh: 开放时间未查到，能进就进，不能进就在门口看看。

reviews.author: Kevin Chan
reviews.text: This temple have almost any version of Buddhist deity inside and also it’s one of the temple sanction by multiple emperor of different era. Very well preserve

reviews.author: Avigdor Hait
reviews.text: A very beautiful and colorful place, a must visit.

query: INNO100, 深圳湾文化广场, 南山区, 深圳

summary.en: Global innovation flagship store in Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza.
summary.zh: 深圳湾文化广场里的全球创新旗舰店。

why.en: Exoskeletons can be tried on and smart glasses tested, which is rare outside trade shows. It sits inside Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza, so the visit flows straight into the bay at sunset.
why.zh: 可以试穿外骨骼、体验智能眼镜，展会以外很少能做到。就在深圳湾文化广场里，看完直接去海边看日落。

zh: 位于深圳湾文化广场内

imageCredit: Brand photo (inno100.ai, store entrance and interior)

query: Ip Man Hall, Foshan Ancestral Temple, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Memorial hall to Foshan-born Wing Chun master Ip Man, teacher of Bruce Lee.
summary.zh: 纪念佛山咏春宗师叶问的展馆，叶问是李小龙的师父。

why.en: Ip Man was born in Foshan and later taught Bruce Lee in Hong Kong. Wooden training dummies (木人桩) are set up for photos, which kids enjoy trying.
why.zh: 叶问生于佛山，后来在香港教出了李小龙。馆内有木人桩可以拍照，孩子喜欢上手试。

en: Ip Man's life and the Wing Chun lineage

reviews.author: K T Lim
reviews.text: Wonderful museum depicting the life of Ip Man - Grandmaster of Wing Chun Kungfu. Master to Hollywood legend Bruce Lee. Practice stations for Wing Chun to test your skills. AI video of Ip Man avatar teaching basic Set of Wing Chun.

reviews.author: Yeo Choon Kuan (Jackson)
reviews.text: We finally got to see the real Yip Man. We always watched movies and the one we saw who portrayed him was the one we had in our minds. It was definitely an eye opener to know the history of this man.

query: 嘉乐蛋挞王 永庆坊 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Egg tart shop in Yongqingfang with eight flavours.
summary.zh: 永庆坊里有8种口味的蛋挞店。

why.en: Egg tarts come out warm in eight flavours, so a mixed box lets everyone try several. A cheap, easy snack between shops.
why.zh: 蛋挞热乎出炉，有8种口味，买一盒混搭大家分着吃；逛店之间的平价小吃。

tips.en: Shop details are from a 2022 guide and may have changed.
tips.zh: 资料来自2022年攻略，可能已变动。

reviews.author: hsu ting Lo
reviews.text: It's cheap, definitely a long-established Guangzhou restaurant. The coconut tarts are also quite good.

query: Jian's Villa, Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Early-Republic Western-style villas built by the founders of Nanyang Brothers Tobacco.
summary.zh: 南洋兄弟烟草公司创始人简氏兄弟建的民初西洋式别墅群。

why.en: The Jian brothers made their fortune with Double Happiness cigarettes, and this is Foshan's largest surviving early-Republic villa group. The balconied “Young Ladies' Tower” tells how unmarried daughters once watched the street without being seen.
why.zh: 简氏兄弟靠红双喜香烟起家，这里是佛山现存最大的民初洋楼群。带阳台的“小姐楼”讲的是未出嫁的小姐如何在楼上看街景。

en: Largest early-Republic villa group in Foshan
Mix of Western and Lingnan details
zh: 佛山现存最大的民初洋楼群

query: Kam's Roast Goose 甘牌燒鵝 226 Hennessy Road Wan Chai Hong Kong

summary.en: Michelin-starred roast goose shop on Hennessy Road, Wan Chai.
summary.zh: 湾仔轩尼诗道的米其林一星烧鹅店。

why.en: Kam's is one of Hong Kong's two famous roast-goose shops and holds a Michelin star. The goose comes with crisp, glossy skin and juicy meat; the leg is the cut to order. It is on the Ding Ding tram line, so it fits between Central and the Star Ferry.
why.zh: 甘牌是香港最有名的两家烧鹅店之一，拿过米其林一星。鹅皮脆亮、肉多汁，点鹅腿最好。就在叮叮车沿线，正好排在中环和天星小轮之间。

tips.en: G/F, Po Wah Commercial Centre, 226 Hennessy Road. Hours ~11:30–21:30; tel +852 2520 1110. Queues are common. Map pin is approximate.
tips.zh: 轩尼诗道226号宝华商业中心地下。营业约11:30–21:30；电话 +852 2520 1110。常要排队。地图位置为大约位置。

reviews.author: Gordon Wheeler
reviews.text: How can one visit Hong Kong and not get roast goose? Goose is apparently the thing in Hong Kong. Our hotel staff recommended Kam's, and we decided to give it a shot. Turns out they have Michelin ⭐. There was a bit of a wait, you go in

reviews.author: Khay Kid Chow
reviews.text: Kam's Roast Goose gives you the HK roast goose experience, from the mandatory queuing, hustle and bustle of HK eatery and great food. The roast goose was flavourful. There is a nice mixture of multiple tastes in every part of the goose as

reviews.author: Mick T
reviews.text: I really wanted to love Kam's Roast Goose, but the experience was a massive letdown. While the food is "decent," it certainly doesn't justify the logistical nightmare and the lack of respect for sit-down diners.

query: Kau Kee Restaurant, 21 Gough Street, Central, Hong Kong

summary.en: Gough Street institution for beef brisket noodles.
summary.zh: 歌赋街老牌牛腩面店。

why.en: Decades-old and run by the same family, it is Hong Kong's benchmark for beef brisket. The clear-broth version shows the beef's flavour without heavy spice, which suits kids.
why.zh: 几十年老店，家族经营，是香港牛腩的标杆。清汤牛腩不靠重料，突出牛肉本味，孩子也能吃。

en: Clear-broth beef brisket with noodles (清汤牛腩面)

tips.en: Queues are common and tables are shared; closed on Sundays and public holidays (should be checked).
tips.zh: 常需排队，需拼桌；周日及公众假期休息（需确认）。

reviews.author: Justin Yiu
reviews.text: Ordered the curry beef brisket tendon with e-fu noodles. First time trying curry flavoured beef tendon noodles. Really, really amazing. Meat was tender and the tendon parts weren’t too tough.

reviews.author: Wilson Tan
reviews.text: This old school street food is an important part of HK food culture that must be preserved in all ways possible. It is situated along a stairway between two buildings.

query: Lan Fong Yuen, 2 Gage Street, Central, Hong Kong

summary.en: Dai pai dong-style café credited with silk-stocking milk tea.
summary.zh: 以丝袜奶茶闻名的大排档式茶餐厅。

why.en: Operating since the 1950s, it is widely credited with popularising Hong Kong's silk-stocking milk tea, strained through a cloth bag. The pork chop bun is a simple, kid-proof lunch.
why.zh: 上世纪50年代开业，被普遍认为是港式丝袜奶茶的发源店，奶茶用布袋反复冲滤。猪扒包简单好吃，孩子一定能接受。

reviews.author: Ethan
reviews.text: Brought here by a native Hong Kong friend, which already felt like a great sign—and it definitely lived up to the recommendation. The place was absolutely bustling with locals, giving it that authentic cha chaan teng atmosphere.

reviews.author: BOUNCINGPLACES Level 9
reviews.text: Lan Fong Yuen is basically a Hong Kong institution. It started way back in 1952 and is the absolute birthplace of that famous "silk stocking" milk tea everyone raves about.

reviews.author: Ashwini Prabhu
reviews.text: Wanted to try a local favourite. We tried the hot and cold milk tea, Pineapple bun, French toast. The tea was mildly sweet and smooth. The pineapple bun was good. The French toast was alright.

query: 李禧记 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Old Foshan biscuit maker, with the Foshan Gong (佛山公) souvenir shop nearby.
summary.zh: 佛山老字号饼家，附近还有佛山公手信店。

why.en: Foshan's classic snacks are bought here in one stop: bengsha (崩砂) crisp biscuits, blind man's cakes (盲公饼) and maltose candy. They travel well and make easy gifts.
why.zh: 佛山经典手信一站买齐：崩砂、盲公饼、麦芽糖。耐放好带，适合送人。

tips.en: Exact shop positions inside Lingnan Tiandi unconfirmed.
tips.zh: 两家店在岭南天地的具体位置未核实。

query: 李众胜堂祖铺 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Original shop of the century-old pharmacy that created Po Chai pills.
summary.zh: 百年老药铺，保济丸的发源地。

why.en: Po Chai pills (保济丸), still sold across southern China and Hong Kong, were first made here in the late Qing dynasty. The wooden loft and chandeliers of the old shop are preserved.
why.zh: 至今在华南和香港仍常见的保济丸，清末就在这里诞生。老铺的木阁楼和吊灯都保留着。

query: 岭南艺苑 湛露直街 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Former home and studio of Lingnan School painters.
summary.zh: 岭南画派大师的旧居画院。

why.en: Lingnan School masters ran an art academy from this house, training a generation of Cantonese painters. A short look from the door adds context to the old streets.
why.zh: 岭南画派大师在这里办画院，培养了一代广东画家；在门口看一眼，老街就多了一层故事。

zh: 第十甫路旁的安静巷子

tips.en: Usually viewed from outside; which painters lived here was not verified.
tips.zh: 一般在门外看；具体是哪位画家的旧居未核实。

query: Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Foshan's restored old quarter: grey-brick lanes, Republic-era villas and food.
summary.zh: 佛山修复的老城区：青砖巷子、民国洋楼和美食。

why.en: Lingnan Tiandi is Foshan's best-preserved old town block, set right beside the Ancestral Temple. Qing-dynasty houses, the Jian family villas and the Wedding House are all within a few minutes' walk. Lunch, local snacks and Foshan souvenirs are found in the same lanes, so no car is needed until mid-afternoon.
why.zh: 岭南天地是佛山保留最完整的老城街区，紧挨祖庙。清代民居、简氏别墅、嫁娶屋都在步行几分钟内；午餐、小吃和佛山手信也在同一片巷子里，下午之前都不用坐车。

en: Blind-man cakes and other Foshan souvenirs

reviews.author: KeeTat Lee
reviews.text: Foshan Lingnan Xintiandi (佛山 / 岭南新天地) A beautifully restored area that blends traditional Lingnan architecture with modern cafés, restaurants, and boutique shops. Great place for a relaxed stroll, photography, and dining.

reviews.author: Gabino Tacoloy
reviews.text: We were looking for an authentic local market and we came across some historical places free to enter. The was an old Cantonese Opera House where we got to see artists practicing for their performance.

reviews.author: 小虫WeiXiang
reviews.text: Beautiful place with lots of cafe and shops available to walk around and explore. Not easy to get lost because most roads are connected

query: Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Landmark tower on the central axis of Lingnan Tiandi, decorated with ceramic sculpture.
summary.zh: 岭南天地中轴线上的地标，墙上有陶瓷雕塑。

why.en: It is the natural starting point and meeting spot in Lingnan Tiandi. Ceramic sculptures and “double happiness” tile patterns on the walls make it a good family photo.
why.zh: 是逛岭南天地的起点和集合点。墙上的陶瓷雕塑和“喜喜”瓦拼花适合拍全家福。

tips.en: Exact name of the tower not verified; navigate to Lingnan Tiandi and ask for 钟楼.
tips.zh: 钟楼正式名称未核实；导航到岭南天地后现场问路。

reviews.author: Peggy L.
reviews.text: A really nice place to visit, with a thoughtful balance between traditional elements and commercial development compared to many similar spots in China. It manages to feel lively without being overwhelming.

reviews.author: maja
reviews.text: Nice place to walk around. Old houses restaurated, lots of suvenir shops.

reviews.author: Cherly Osa
reviews.text: Such a nice place and a must visit when you're in Foshan. The ambience is just wonderful.

query: 文会里嫁娶屋 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Traditional house once used for weddings, now showing old Foshan wedding customs.
summary.zh: 旧时办婚礼的大屋，现在展示佛山传统婚嫁习俗。

why.en: Old Cantonese wedding customs are explained through the rooms. Wedding dress and a bridal sedan chair can be tried for photos, which kids tend to love.
why.zh: 通过房间布置讲解旧时广府婚俗。可以穿喜服、坐花轿拍照，孩子通常很喜欢。

en: Wedding dress and sedan chair photos

tips.en: Dress-up may be a paid add-on; check on site.
tips.zh: 换装拍照可能另外收费，以现场为准。

query: LINLEE手打柠檬茶 北京路168号 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Hand-pounded lemon tea on Beijing Road.
summary.zh: 北京路上的手打柠檬茶。

why.en: LINLEE is the brand most associated with Guangzhou’s hand-pounded lemon tea craze. Fresh lemons are pounded by hand into strong black or green tea, so it is sharp, fragrant and not too sweet. Sugar level can be adjusted when ordering.
why.zh: LINLEE 是广州手打柠檬茶热潮里最有代表性的品牌。新鲜柠檬现场手打，配浓茶底，香气足、酸爽不腻；点单时可以选甜度。

tips.en: Map pin is approximate (168 Beijing Road).
tips.zh: 地图位置为估算（北京路168号）。

imageCredit: Wikimedia Commons, MPCROOYW GROAHMOIOE, CC0 (another branch)

query: LINLEE Central Lyndhurst Terrace Shop Hong Kong

summary.en: Hand-pounded lemon tea on Lyndhurst Terrace, next to Tai Cheong Bakery.
summary.zh: 摆花街上的手打柠檬茶，就在泰昌饼家旁边。

why.en: LINLEE is the brand most associated with Guangzhou’s hand-pounded lemon tea craze. Fresh lemons are pounded by hand into strong black or green tea, so it is sharp, fragrant and not too sweet. Sugar level can be adjusted when ordering.
why.zh: LINLEE 是广州手打柠檬茶热潮里最有代表性的品牌。新鲜柠檬现场手打，配浓茶底，香气足、酸爽不腻；点单时可以选甜度。

query: LINLEE手打柠檬茶 正佳广场负一层 天河区 广州

summary.en: Hand-pounded lemon tea in Grandview Mall B1.
summary.zh: 正佳广场负一层的手打柠檬茶。

why.en: LINLEE is the brand most associated with Guangzhou’s hand-pounded lemon tea craze. Fresh lemons are pounded by hand into strong black or green tea, so it is sharp, fragrant and not too sweet. Sugar level can be adjusted when ordering.
why.zh: LINLEE 是广州手打柠檬茶热潮里最有代表性的品牌。新鲜柠檬现场手打，配浓茶底，香气足、酸爽不腻；点单时可以选甜度。

tips.en: Map pin is the mall; the shop is on B1.
tips.zh: 地图位置为商场，店在负一层。
