query: LINLEE手打柠檬茶 流花路城壹汇 越秀公园地铁站 广州

summary.en: Hand-pounded lemon tea by Yuexiu Park Metro, near the Baima market area.
summary.zh: 越秀公园地铁站旁的手打柠檬茶，靠近白马一带。

why.en: LINLEE is the brand most associated with Guangzhou’s hand-pounded lemon tea craze. Fresh lemons are pounded by hand into strong black or green tea, so it is sharp, fragrant and not too sweet. Sugar level can be adjusted when ordering.
why.zh: LINLEE 是广州手打柠檬茶热潮里最有代表性的品牌。新鲜柠檬现场手打，配浓茶底，香气足、酸爽不腻；点单时可以选甜度。

tips.en: Map pin is approximate; the shop is in Chengyi Hui mall B1, by Metro exit C.
tips.zh: 地图位置为估算，店在城壹汇负一层，越秀公园地铁站C口旁。

imageCredit: Wikimedia Commons, Elaodou Anudyem Lukas, CC0 (another branch)

query: Liugeng Hall, Shawan Ancient Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Five-courtyard Yuan-era ancestral hall, with an evening 3D projection on its façade.
summary.zh: 始建于元代的五进大祠堂，晚上外墙有3D投影。

why.en: One of the largest ancestral halls in the Pearl River Delta, with massive timber columns, the “诗书世泽” plaque and oyster-shell windows. After dark, a projection on the façade tells the town's musical history.
why.zh: 珠三角最大的祠堂之一，有巨大木柱、“诗书世泽”牌匾和蚝壳窗；入夜外墙投影讲古镇的音乐故事。

tips.en: Projection schedule is not confirmed; check on site.
tips.zh: 投影是否放映以现场为准。

reviews.author: Weiming Ho
reviews.text: Located in Shawan Ancient Town, this ancestral hall and clan temple, which was first built in the Song Dynasty, has been renovated and is more and more magnificent as descendants of the ancestors have passed the imperial examinations. It is well worth a visit.

reviews.author: 亮亮
reviews.text: The He Clan Ancestral Hall is of great historical value and worth visiting.

reviews.author: wei xie (谢伟)
reviews.text: There weren't many people, but the Lingnan culture was very strong!

query: Liwan Lake Park, Longjin West Road, Guangzhou

summary.en: Lakeside park in old Xiguan, with a small Qing-style garden.
summary.zh: 西关老城的湖景公园，有清代风格小园林。

why.en: A morning here shows everyday Guangzhou: elderly locals singing Cantonese opera, tai chi and dancing by the water. The small Xiaohuafangzhai (小画舫斋) garden is a compact example of Lingnan garden design.
why.zh: 早上来能看到广州人的日常：老人唱粤曲、打太极、跳舞；小画舫斋是一座小巧的岭南园林。

reviews.author: Torpong Chiamtawongse
reviews.text: This park is in Liwan, Guangzhou. It is very nice park where integrate the new technology and lives to the local lives. The park is so shady, safe, and very nice design to match the landscape as well.

reviews.author: Rob Nesbit
reviews.text: Nice park, good to walk around, and a lot of lovely small cafes, restaurants and even craft bars near here, near and along the small side streets.

reviews.author: Bob Smith
reviews.text: Beautifully kept park in Liwan district. Very clean and tidy. A really nice place to relax for a while. Fairly close to the Cantonese national opera museum and to Shamian.

query: Liwan Plaza, Xiajiu Road, Liwan, Guangzhou

summary.en: Long-established mall of jewellery, watch and small-goods shops.
summary.zh: 老牌商场，首饰、手表、小商品店多。

why.en: Floors of small independent stalls sell accessories, jewellery, watches and stationery at wholesale-style prices. Kids can spend pocket money on hair clips, stickers and trinkets.
why.zh: 一层层独立小档口卖饰品、首饰、手表、文具，价格接近批发；小孩可以用零花钱买发夹、贴纸、小玩意。

tips.en: Bargaining is common at stalls.
tips.zh: 档口一般可以讲价。

query: 龙塘诗社 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Two-storey white building mixing Chinese and Western styles, on the site of a Qing literati garden.
summary.zh: 中西合璧的两层小白楼，前身是清代文人雅集的花园。

why.en: A quiet stop between busier streets, with clean white façades that photograph well. Rotating exhibitions are often held inside.
why.zh: 热闹街区里的安静一站，白色立面拍照好看，楼内常有展览。

tips.en: Exhibitions vary and may not be on.
tips.zh: 展览不固定，可能当天没有。

query: Lychee Bay (荔枝湾涌), Liwan, Guangzhou

summary.en: Restored canal lined with Xiguan houses, with Wenta Pagoda.
summary.zh: 两岸是西关民居的河涌，还有文塔。

why.en: The canal was uncovered and restored in 2010, bringing back stone bridges and old-house frontages. It is the birthplace of sampan congee (艇仔粥), once sold from boats. Wenta, a small Ming-era brick pagoda, makes a good photo stop.
why.zh: 2010年揭盖复涌，恢复了石桥和老屋沿河景观；这里是艇仔粥的发源地，以前在艇上卖；文塔是明代小砖塔，适合拍照。

tips.en: Wenta's dating is from memory.
tips.zh: 文塔年代凭记忆。

reviews.author: Mieko Glenn
reviews.text: Good spot to walk around and enjoy the scenery of old, historic part of the city. There's one of the houses of Bruce Lee's family (where Bruce's father grew up as a child, now a museum for free).

reviews.author: Didier Pascal
reviews.text: Should be a crime visiting this ancient and beautiful neighborhood alone, especially at night. The place offers such a beautiful scenery for photoshoots and romantic strolls

query: Madame Tussauds Hong Kong, The Peak Tower, Hong Kong

summary.en: Wax museum inside The Peak Tower.
summary.zh: 位于山顶凌霄阁内的蜡像馆。

why.en: Celebrities and athletes can be photographed up close, with props and sets to pose in. It sits at the top of the Peak Tram, so no extra travel is needed.
why.zh: 可以和明星、运动员蜡像近距离合照，还有道具和布景。就在山顶缆车终点，不用另外坐车。

zh: 和明星蜡像近距离合照

tips.en: Tickets should be bought online in advance; the combo with the Peak Tram saves queuing.
tips.zh: 门票提前网上买，和山顶缆车套票可省排队。

reviews.author: Anupam Sah
reviews.text: Visited Madame Tussauds Hong Kong on Victoria Peak and it was a highlight of our trip.

reviews.author: Fabyana Ong
reviews.text: It was so quiet during our visit on 15th oct , so we managed to took pictures without having to wait in line, it was so pleasant, the staff were nice too. My kid loved the projection games on the floor and dancing on the stages.

reviews.author: sarath krishnan
reviews.text: Felt bigger than Singapore one...there is lot of spots for taking photos apart from celebrity statues

query: Mall of the World (花城汇), Huacheng Square, Guangzhou

summary.en: Underground mall beneath Huacheng Square.
summary.zh: 花城广场地下的商场。

why.en: Entered straight from the plaza, it offers a warm indoor stop with dessert counters, including fresh crêpes and waffles. Taxis can be taken from the entrance afterwards.
why.zh: 从广场直接下去，室内暖和，有可丽饼、松饼等现做甜品；吃完在门口打车。

tips.en: Specific dessert shops were not named in the plan; choose on site.
tips.zh: 行程没指定具体甜品店，现场挑。

query: Central–Mid-Levels Escalator Hong Kong

summary.en: Covered outdoor escalator up the hill from Central; free.
summary.zh: 从中环往半山的户外有盖扶梯，免费。

why.en: Billed as the world's longest outdoor covered escalator system, it climbs from Central through the old streets towards the Mid-Levels. A short ride is a Hong Kong-only experience for kids, and it starts right by Tai Cheong Bakery and Lan Fong Yuen.
why.zh: 号称世界最长的户外有盖扶梯系统，从中环穿过老街一路往半山。坐一小段就是只有香港才有的体验，起点就在泰昌饼家和兰芳园旁边。

tips.en: It runs downhill in the morning and uphill from ~10:00. Map pin is approximate.
tips.zh: 早上往下行，约10:00后改为往上行。地图位置为大约位置。

reviews.author: Kong Wen Sheng
reviews.text: 28 June 2026- It was raining and we decided not to take the cable car up the Peak tram now. We took a taxi over and explored this Central-Mid level escalators. Very interesting to link up majority of this area with escalators. We just

reviews.author: Nitin Subhash
reviews.text: The Central–Mid-Levels Escalator is a unique Hong Kong experience, an 800-meter covered ride through bustling streets, linking Central to the Mid-Levels. It's both practical and fun, offering glimpses of cafés, shops, and local life along the way. A quirky urban adventure worth trying.

reviews.author: Daphne Partridge
reviews.text: Take the escalators the walk a little higher (look out for small brown signs) and suddenly you're at the Tai Kwun: revitalized colonial police station and prison complex wbich has been transformed into a cultural heritage and arts

query: MixC Shenzhen Bay, Nanshan, Shenzhen

summary.en: Large mall near Shenzhen Bay with many restaurants.
summary.zh: 深圳湾附近餐厅众多的大型商场。

why.en: The widest choice of restaurants near the bay, all under one roof. Pick-up is easy afterwards for the drive to Shenzhen North.
why.zh: 深圳湾附近餐厅选择最多，全在室内。吃完方便上车去深圳北。

reviews.author: SuperAuis Nantawan N.
reviews.text: The MixC Shenzhen is one of the most impressive lifestyle malls I've visited. It features both indoor and outdoor areas, creating a great atmosphere for shopping, dining, and simply spending the day.

reviews.author: Whiskey Tea
reviews.text: Beautiful urban Mall,in Nan Shan. It’s about 20 minutes from FuTian. The mall is made up of different building and there is a pedestrian mall for you to walk to the different parts of the building.

query: 野人先生 gelato Tianhe Road, Guangzhou

summary.en: Chinese gelato chain, made fresh in-store each day with many rotating flavours.
summary.zh: 国内连锁意式冰淇淋店，每天店内现做，口味多且常换。

why.en: Gelato is made in-store daily, and local flavours appear next to Italian classics. Tasting is offered before choosing, so kids can try several.
why.zh: 每天店内现做，除了经典意式口味，还有本地特色口味。可以先试吃再选，孩子能多试几种。

zh: 天河路一带有多家分店

tips.en: English brand name and exact branch unconfirmed; search “野人先生” in Amap and pick the nearest Tianhe Road branch.
tips.zh: 英文名和具体分店未核实；在高德搜“野人先生”，选天河路附近的分店。

imageCredit: Wikimedia Commons, WAOSNMAH wocnaprm, CC0 (another branch)

query: 南信牛奶甜品专家 第十甫路 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Xiguan's best-known milk-dessert shop, on Dishifu Road.
summary.zh: 西关最有名的牛奶甜品店，就在第十甫路。

why.en: Double-skin milk custard is made fresh here from buffalo milk and served warm or chilled. The texture is silkier and the milk flavour stronger than chain versions. It is a 2-minute walk from the Shangxiajiu arcades, so it is easily fitted in.
why.zh: 双皮奶用水牛奶现做，冷热都有，口感比连锁店更滑、奶味更浓。离上下九骑楼只要步行两分钟，顺路就能吃。

en: Red bean milk custard (红豆双皮奶)

tips.en: Queues form after dinner; turnover is fast.
tips.zh: 晚饭后会排队，但翻台很快。

reviews.author: Bugwagen
reviews.text: Love the hot double milk curd 传统凤凰炒奶糊, the ginger milk curd 南信姜汁撞奶, and sesame paste ball 石磨黑芝麻糊汤丸. We added red beans to our hot double milk curd and it was good.

reviews.author: MCL
reviews.text: Guangzhou unique flavors. Good for a light dinner complete with desserts. Have been around since 1934. Just across the road from Tao Tao Ju!!

reviews.author: Jo Lee
reviews.text: Overall summary (3.5/5): A famous, authentic spot for classic Cantonese desserts. The food(3.5/5): The Red Bean Double Skin Milk (红豆双皮奶, ¥17) was the highlight. It was smooth with a good rich milk taste, and the red beans were soft.

query: 吴财记面家 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Neighbourhood noodle house known for shrimp wontons.
summary.zh: 街坊面家，以鲜虾云吞出名。

why.en: Wontons are packed with whole fresh shrimp, and the fried wontons are a crunchy snack kids pick up by hand. A quick, cheap Xiguan lunch.
why.zh: 云吞包整只鲜虾，炸云吞香脆，小孩可以直接用手拿着吃；快捷平价的西关午餐。

en: Fresh shrimp wonton noodles (鲜虾云吞面)

tips.en: The plan lists it on Datong Road; the exact address was not verified. Search the name in Amap before going.
tips.zh: 行程写在大同路，具体地址未核实，出发前在高德搜店名确认。

reviews.author: TiXuan LI
reviews.text: Just had one of the best bowls of wonton noodle soup I’ve ever tasted in Guangzhou! 🍜 The handmade wontons were plump, juicy, and full of flavor, swimming in a light but incredibly rich and savory broth.

reviews.author: Bugwagen
reviews.text: A bib gourmand restaurant located in a street alley across a mall. I found the noodles to be average as we ordered dry version. Should order the soup version I supposed. The wantons are good.

query: 伍湛记 龙津东路 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Long-standing congee shop on Longjin East Road.
summary.zh: 龙津东路老字号粥店。

why.en: Jidi congee (及第粥), with pork liver, kidney and meatballs, is a classic Guangzhou breakfast and is cooked here to order. Salty fried dough cakes (咸煎饼) are a mild, bready side that children usually like.
why.zh: 及第粥是广州经典早餐，猪肝、猪腰、肉丸现煲；咸煎饼口味温和，小孩一般都爱吃。

reviews.author: Junhua Chen
reviews.text: A decent breakfast place, it opens at 6am! 干炒牛河 Beef stir fry noodles is really good. And the 猪肝粥 pork liver congee is also good.

reviews.author: Rock kid Brothers
reviews.text: The beef chow fun portion is roughly for four people, so please consider this before ordering. It's a bit oily, but the taste is good.

reviews.author: cat
reviews.text: The only thing I love from them is the fried dough, definitely the best in the city.

query: Our Lady of Lourdes Chapel, Shamian Street, Guangzhou

summary.en: Small cream-white Catholic chapel on Shamian Street.
summary.zh: 沙面大街上的米白色小教堂。

why.en: Built by the French in 1892, it is one of the island's signature buildings and its most photographed façade. A photo from the street takes only a few minutes.
why.zh: 1892年由法国人建成，是沙面的标志建筑，也是岛上最多人拍照的立面；在街上拍几张就好。

en: On the main Shamian walking route

tips.en: Usually viewed from outside; interior access is limited.
tips.zh: 一般在门外看，内部不一定开放。

reviews.author: NOOR MOHAMMAD
reviews.text: Our Lady of Lourdes Chapel on Shamian Island is a peaceful and historically rich landmark that offers a quiet escape from the busy city of Guangzhou.

reviews.author: gevs
reviews.text: I came across this beautiful chapel when I was in Guangzhou recently. It has some really beautiful stained glass windows. The compound wasn't that big but it was filled with a number of nice sculptures and statues. The chapel's interior was cool and serene.

reviews.author: Google Lum
reviews.text: Happened to come across this church walking through Shamian park in November recently. The doors were opened and welcoming. Nice stained glass windows but no paintings. Before this went to the Christ Church nearby but it isn't found in Maps.

query: Chimelong Panda Hotel lobby bar, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Lobby lounge for Western cakes and hot drinks.
summary.zh: 大堂吧，西式蛋糕和热饮。

why.en: A seated break between the resort walk and check-in, in the panda-decorated lobby.
why.zh: 熟悉度假区之后、入住之前，可以在熊猫装饰的大堂坐下休息。

query: Chimelong Panda Hotel restaurant, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: In-hotel dining with panda-shaped cakes and buffet meals.
summary.zh: 酒店内餐厅，有自助餐和熊猫造型蛋糕。

why.en: No travel is needed between park and meal, which matters on show nights. Panda-shaped desserts are made here and are a photo the kids will ask for.
why.zh: 不用出门就能吃，有演出的晚上最省时间。熊猫造型甜点在这里做，孩子一定会要拍。

tips.en: The hotel has more than one outlet; exact restaurant names and hours should be checked at reception. Buffet is crowded at opening even in low season.
tips.zh: 酒店有多个餐厅，具体名称和营业时间以前台为准；自助餐淡季开门时也很挤。

query: 泮溪酒家 龙津西路151号 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Garden restaurant by Liwan Lake, famed for its dim sum.
summary.zh: 荔湾湖旁的园林酒家，点心出名。

why.en: Founded in 1947, it is one of the largest garden restaurants in Guangzhou, with pavilions, ponds and rockeries. Its white rabbit dumplings are the most photographed dim sum in the city, and kids love them.
why.zh: 1947年创办，广州最大的园林酒家之一，亭台、池塘、假山都有；白兔饺是全城最上镜的点心，小孩最喜欢。

en: Eight famous dim sum and dishes
Eight-treasure winter melon soup (八宝冬瓜盅)

tips.en: Booking ahead is recommended; window seats in the garden go early.
tips.zh: 建议提前订位，园林靠窗位置要早订。

reviews.author: L-C
reviews.text: China's time-honored restaurant serving dim sum in the morning and others for lunch and dinner.

reviews.author: derek neo
reviews.text: 泮溪酒家 Panxi Restaurant has the grand setting and reputation to match. We came for lunch expecting a lot, given the accolades. The service was good - attentive and professional. But the food didn’t live up to the hype for us.

query: Parc Central, Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: Sunken, mostly underground mall beside Teemall.
summary.zh: 天河城旁以地下为主的下沉式商场。

why.en: Quieter than the neighbouring malls, with a landscaped sunken garden at its centre. It is walked through underground from Teemall, so no street crossing is needed with kids.
why.zh: 比周边商场安静，中间是下沉式园林。从天河城地下直接走过去，带孩子不用过马路。

reviews.author: YC Khong
reviews.text: Nice mall with futuristic features. Lots of shopping and eateries. The outdoor was beautifully decorated with CNY season.

reviews.author: Mimi Goh
reviews.text: Been here for the holiday. Quite crowded with locals. The mall itself is just like any other branded mall—people mainly come for the pretty Christmas decorations. There is direct metro access, and although it looks busy, the crowd flow is still smooth.

query: Peak Tram Garden Road Lower Terminus, Central, Hong Kong

summary.en: Funicular from Garden Road to Victoria Peak, running since 1888.
summary.zh: 1888年开通，从花园道到太平山顶的缆车。

why.en: Asia's oldest funicular climbs so steeply that the buildings outside appear to lean. Kids remember the tilt long after the view.
why.zh: 亚洲最早的登山缆车，坡度很陡，窗外高楼看起来像是倾斜的。孩子对倾斜的感觉记得比风景还久。

tips.en: Queues can be long; a Madame Tussauds + Peak Tram combo ticket gives a dedicated lane. Sit on the right going up for the harbour view.
tips.zh: 排队可能很长，买蜡像馆加缆车套票有专用通道。上山坐右边看海景。

reviews.author: akhil shanbhag
reviews.text: Bought tickets at the counter - waited in the queue about 10 minutes on a Sunday morning. Queue moves fast. Paid with credit card.

reviews.author: K Ooi
reviews.text: The Peak Tram is definitely one of the must-try experiences when visiting Hong Kong.

reviews.author: Thameur Hamza
reviews.text: Riding The Peak Tram is an absolute must-do historical and visual journey that seamlessly links the high-rises of Central to the cool heights of Victoria Peak!

query: Tianzi Pier, Yanjiang Middle Road, Yuexiu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Evening boat cruise along the Pearl River past the lit-up Canton Tower and city skyline.
summary.zh: 夜晚沿珠江坐船，看灯光下的广州塔和两岸夜景。

why.en: Guangzhou's skyline is seen at its best from the water: Canton Tower, Haizhu Bridge and the Bund-style buildings along Yanjiang Road are all lit up. Kids get a boat ride without much walking at the end of the day.
why.zh: 从江上看广州夜景最好：广州塔、海珠桥、沿江路的老建筑都亮灯。一天下来不用多走路，孩子还能坐船。

tips.en: Tickets and pier should be confirmed in advance; be at the pier 20 min early and bring a jacket.
tips.zh: 船票和码头提前确定；开船前20分钟到，带外套。

reviews.author: Colin Leung
reviews.text: 100% must do attraction in Guangzhou! River Cruise to Canton Tower to see the beautiful lights along the river. $27 CDN per adult. Has option to eat dinner there too, but wouldn’t recommend. Eat before hand and enjoy the experience fully. A+++++

reviews.author: K T Lim
reviews.text: Excellent River Pearl River Cruise. Need Passport for international tourists. Security check required via metal detector Suggest to book level 2 tickets with table number - free water or hot tea with a packet of peas.

reviews.author: Google Lum
reviews.text: Came here in November recently one late beautiful night. The promenade along the river is a great place to view the city lights, could see the Guangzhou tower distance away (we went closer on another night).

query: Qinghui Garden, 23 Qinghui Road, Daliang, Shunde, Foshan

summary.en: One of the Four Great Gardens of Lingnan, a Ming-Qing private garden in central Daliang.
summary.zh: 岭南四大名园之一，大良城中的明清私家园林。

why.en: Lingnan garden design is seen at its most compact here: bridges, ponds, bamboo and carved windows fitted into a small town plot. Paths and small bridges keep kids exploring, and a full loop takes only about 50 minutes.
why.zh: 岭南园林在小块地上把小桥、水池、竹林和花窗安排得很紧凑。小路和小桥让孩子一路探索，走一圈约50分钟。

en: One of the Four Great Gardens of Lingnan

tips.en: Closes in the early evening; check the last-entry time at the gate.
tips.zh: 傍晚关门，到门口先看入园截止时间。

reviews.author: Julian Wong
reviews.text: Another classical Lingnan mansion and garden that is worth your visit if you are in this area. The buildings are well maintained and the garden is exquisite. A great place to understand Chinese southern culture.

reviews.author: Lenzo Chan
reviews.text: A must-visit park in Shunde! The garden is incredibly relaxing with beautiful Chinese architecture—perfect for chilling out before or after hitting the neighboring food street

aliases: 丘大叔柠檬茶（天河南店）

name.zh: 丘大叔柠檬茶（天河南店）

query: 丘大叔柠檬茶 天河南路80号 天河区 广州

summary.en: The shop that made duck-shit oolong lemon tea famous.
summary.zh: 把鸭屎香柠檬茶带火的店。

why.en: Uncle Qiu popularised lemon tea made with duck-shit oolong (鸭屎香), a Phoenix dancong tea named for its soil, not its taste. The tea gives a floral, honeyed aroma under the lemon. It is between K Hotel and Grandview Mall.
why.zh: 丘大叔把鸭屎香柠檬茶带火：鸭屎香是凤凰单丛的一种，名字来自土壤，跟味道无关，茶香带花蜜味。店就在 K Hotel 和正佳之间。

en: Duck-shit oolong lemon tea (鸭屎香柠檬茶)

imageCredit: Wikimedia Commons, MPCROOYW GROAHMOIOE, CC0 (another branch)

query: 机器人6S店, 星河WORLD, 坂田, 龙岗区, 深圳

summary.en: The world's first robot 6S store, in Galaxy WORLD, Bantian.
summary.zh: 全球首家机器人6S店，位于坂田星河WORLD园区。

why.en: Humanoid robots and robot dogs from Chinese makers such as Unitree, Leju and DEEP Robotics are shown working, not behind glass. Robots cook jianbing and make coffee that can be bought and eaten. Few places let children see this much current Chinese robotics in one room.
why.zh: 宇树、乐聚、云深处等国内厂商的人形机器人和机器狗现场演示，不是隔着玻璃看。机器人现场做煎饼果子、冲咖啡，可以买来吃。很少有地方能让孩子在一个店里看到这么多国产机器人。

en: Humanoid robot and robot dog demos
zh: 机器人现场做煎饼、冲咖啡
人形机器人、机器狗现场展示
零部件超市：伺服电机、减速器
机器人出租，约1000元一天起

tips.en: Opening hours and live-demo times should be checked before the visit.
tips.zh: 出发前确认营业时间和现场演示时间。

name.en: Daliang Rongbian Spare Rib Rice, Branch 3

query: 容边排骨饭 三店, Guangfeng Building, Daliang, Shunde, Foshan

summary.en: Local spare-rib rice institution beside Qinghui Garden and Huagai Road.
summary.zh: 清晖园和华盖路旁的本地排骨饭名店。

why.en: Spare ribs are steamed directly on the rice in individual bowls, so the juices soak into the grains — a plain dish done exactly right. Sizzling clay pots and meatball soup round it out, and double-skin milk (双皮奶), which originated in Daliang, finishes the meal.
why.zh: 排骨直接铺在米饭上一碗一碗蒸，肉汁渗进饭里，简单但做得到位。再配啫啫煲、肉丸汤，最后来一碗大良发源的双皮奶。

en: Steamed spare rib rice (干蒸排骨饭)

tips.en: 2/F Guangfeng Building (广丰大厦二楼). Arrive at 17:30 to avoid queues. Tel 13450801998.
tips.zh: 广丰大厦二楼；17:30开门就到，不用排队。电话13450801998。

name.zh: 润园四季椰子鸡（欢乐海岸店）

query: 润园四季椰子鸡 白石路东8号欢乐海岸5栋F2 南山 深圳

summary.en: Shenzhen's best-known coconut chicken hotpot chain.
summary.zh: 深圳最出名的椰子鸡连锁。

why.en: Coconut chicken is a Shenzhen speciality: fresh coconut water is used as the hotpot broth, and Wenchang chicken is cooked in it. The broth is light and sweet, so children usually drink it by the bowl.
why.zh: 椰子鸡是深圳特色：用新鲜椰子水做锅底，涮文昌鸡。汤清甜不油腻，孩子通常一碗接一碗。

tips.en: Branch: OCT Harbour (欢乐海岸), Building 5, 2F, 8 Baishi Road East — the nearest branch to Shenzhen Bay on Google Maps, ~15 min by car from Talent Park. The address should be shown to the driver.
tips.zh: 分店：欢乐海岸5栋2楼（白石路东8号），是 Google 地图上离深圳湾最近的分店，从人才公园开车约15分钟；把地址给司机看。

reviews.author: Wang's
reviews.text: On holidays, there's about a 30-minute wait. Hainan coconut chicken soup is a must-try hot pot in Shenzhen. Ordering a two-person set meal online is more economical. The clay pot rice was too much to finish—it's a huge pot!

reviews.author: Lisa Tang
reviews.text: Coconut chicken soup was so good. But the shop is not easy to locate because it is on the 2nd floor and you can't see it from ground floor.

query: 沙河服装城, 沙河, 天河区, 广州

summary.en: Large wholesale clothing district in Shahe, Tianhe.
summary.zh: 天河区沙河的大型服装批发市场。

why.en: T-shirts, denim and casual wear are sold at wholesale prices, and bargaining is expected. It shows the trading side of Guangzhou that malls do not.
why.zh: T恤、牛仔、休闲装批发价，可以讲价。能看到商场以外的广州批发贸易一面。

tips.en: Stalls are fullest in the morning; many close in the afternoon. Crowded: backpacks on the front, phones away. Metro: Shaheding (沙河顶).
tips.zh: 上午档口最齐，下午不少收档。人多拥挤，背包背前面，手机收好。地铁：沙河顶站。

reviews.author: Hussain Buzaid
reviews.text: Huge wholesale market with average quality and cheap prices.

reviews.author: Quang Si
reviews.text: very very busy. shops and people everywhere.

query: Shamian Island, Liwan, Guangzhou

summary.en: Former foreign concession island of colonial buildings and banyan-lined streets.
summary.zh: 百年前的租界小岛，满是欧式建筑和大榕树。

why.en: From 1859 the island was the British and French concession, and over 150 European-style consulates, banks and trading houses still stand, most with plaques. It is car-light and flat, so kids can walk freely and hunt for the life-size bronze statues along the streets. The southern edge opens onto a Pearl River promenade.
why.zh: 1859年起为英法租界，至今保留150多栋欧式领事馆、银行、洋行，大多有铭牌介绍；岛上车少路平，小孩可以放心走，一路找真人大小的铜像合影；南边就是珠江边步道。

en: Bronze street statues for a kids' hunt
Quiet and photogenic in the morning
zh: 街头铜像，适合小孩寻宝

tips.en: Arrive after 09:00, before the crowds. Several cafés and riverside Western restaurants on Shamian South Street serve light lunches.
tips.zh: 九点多到，人少。沙面南街一带有多家咖啡馆和江边西餐厅，可吃轻食午餐。

reviews.author: Han Lee
reviews.text: Small touristy island on its own with colonial style buildings - so diff from the rest of Guangzhou.

query: Shamian Park, Shamian Island, Guangzhou

summary.en: Small riverside park with lawns and benches.
summary.zh: 岛上有草地和长椅的小公园。

why.en: A shaded green space mid-walk where kids can run and adults can sit. It overlooks the river, so the break comes with a view.
why.zh: 走到一半让小孩跑跳、大人坐下的树荫绿地，还能看江景。

query: Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, Liwan, Guangzhou

summary.en: Guangzhou's most complete qilou arcade street.
summary.zh: 广州最完整的骑楼街。

why.en: Over a kilometre of continuous qilou arcades runs along Dishifu, Xiajiu and Shangjiu roads, with heritage brands such as Tao Tao Ju and Lin Heung Lau at the west end. Budget clothes, snacks and souvenir shops line both sides, and the covered walkways keep everyone out of sun and rain.
why.zh: 第十甫路、下九路、上九路连成一公里多的骑楼街，西头有陶陶居、莲香楼等老字号；两边是平价服装、小吃、手信店，骑楼下走路晒不到也淋不到。

en: Wenlan Lane, linked to Qing-era Thirteen Hongs merchants
zh: 文澜巷，与清代十三行商人有关

tips.en: Crowded in the evening; backpacks should be worn on the front.
tips.zh: 傍晚人多，背包背在前面。

query: Shawan Ancient Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: 800-year-old Lingnan town with ancestral halls, a pagoda and a weekend night market.
summary.zh: 800多年历史的岭南古镇，有祠堂、古塔和周末夜市。

why.en: Founded in the Southern Song, it keeps wok-ear gabled houses, flagstone lanes and the He clan's great ancestral hall. Ginger milk curd originated here. Compact and free, it is walked in two hours.
why.zh: 南宋始建，保留镬耳屋、石板街和何氏大宗祠；姜撞奶的发源地。古镇不大、免费，两小时可以走完。

tips.en: Flagstone streets; wear comfortable shoes and bring a jacket for the evening.
tips.zh: 石板路，穿好走的鞋；晚上冷，带外套。

reviews.author: rn_1604
reviews.text: Shawan Ancient Town is huge! Take your time to stroll along the alleyways and explore through time. You can easily take a day to roam around investigating every nook and cranny. Plenty of shops and food as well. Lovely ancient town.

reviews.author: Rob Nesbit
reviews.text: An ancient town in the Panyu District of Guangzhou - on the outskirts of the city Many side streets, with cool little cafes and eateries, souvenir shops, and interesting art and architecture to see, while the main street of Panyu in itself is also worth…

reviews.author: Julian Wong
reviews.text: This ancient settlement is very big and is a living settlement. There are residents actually living in the area. There are a two entrance, the more popular one is the south entrance. The more touristy area with more commercialization.

query: Anning Square, Shawan Ancient Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Evening craft market, ~17:30–19:00.
summary.zh: 傍晚手作市集，约17:30至19:00。

why.en: Local embroidery, copperware and tea are sold by makers under lights; the adjacent Guangdong Music Hall has weekend performances.
why.zh: 灯光下卖本地刺绣、铜器和茶叶；旁边的广东音乐馆周末有表演。

tips.en: Market days and hours are not confirmed for late December.
tips.zh: 12月下旬是否开市及时间未确认。

aliases: 沙湾姜撞奶老屋甜品店

name.en: Shawan Ginger Milk Curd Old House
name.zh: 沙湾姜撞奶老屋甜品店

query: 姜撞奶 甜品 沙湾古镇, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Dessert shop in a century-old house with a courtyard.
summary.zh: 百年老屋改的甜品店，有小院子。

why.en: Ginger milk curd was invented in Shawan: hot buffalo milk is poured onto fresh ginger juice and sets in seconds. Eating it in the town of origin, in a courtyard house, is the point of the evening.
why.zh: 姜撞奶起源于沙湾：热水牛奶冲进鲜姜汁，几秒就凝固。在发源地的老屋小院里吃，是这一晚的重点。

en: Origin town of ginger milk curd

tips.en: Shop name as given in the itinerary; exact shopfront should be confirmed on Dianping.
tips.zh: 店名按行程；具体门店以大众点评为准。

query: Wenfeng Pagoda, Shawan Ancient Town, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Seven-storey pagoda overlooking the old town's wok-ear rooftops.
summary.zh: 七层古塔，可俯瞰古镇镬耳屋顶。

why.en: The best view of Shawan's rooftops, with wind chimes ringing at dusk. Nearby lanes hold the old pawnshop, Jinshi Gate and old rice mill.
why.zh: 看沙湾屋顶的最佳位置，黄昏风铃作响；附近古街有当楼、进士第门楼和老米机。

en: Old pawnshop and rice mill nearby

query: Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza, Nanshan, Shenzhen

summary.en: New cultural landmark on the Shenzhen Bay waterfront.
summary.zh: 深圳湾海边的新文化地标。

why.en: The building itself is the attraction: sculptural forms right by the bay that photograph well in late-afternoon light. INNO100 is inside, and Talent Park is ~10 min away by car.
why.zh: 建筑本身就是看点：造型独特，紧邻海湾，傍晚光线下很好拍。INNO100就在里面，到人才公园车程约10分钟。

imageCredit: Wikimedia Commons, NAN LIU, CC BY-SA 4.0

name.en: Talent Park and Shenzhen Bay Park

query: Shenzhen Talent Park, Nanshan, Shenzhen

summary.en: Seafront parks for sunset and the lit-up Houhai skyline.
summary.zh: 看日落和后海高楼夜景的海滨公园。

why.en: Sunset over Shenzhen Bay is around 17:50 in late December, watched from a flat seafront promenade that is easy for kids. After dark, the Houhai towers across the lake are lit up, best seen from Talent Park.
why.zh: 12月底深圳湾日落约17:50，海边步道平坦，孩子走起来轻松。天黑后人才公园对面后海高楼亮灯。

reviews.author: ng jiannan
reviews.text: A huge park great for strolling, relax and have a picnic. It is interlinked by park connectors by the Shenzhen bay area. Amazing photo spots for Shenzhen's iconic building landscape.

reviews.author: sokhanearyroat ung
reviews.text: beautiful park, beautiful night view with a sea of skyscrapers facing the park😍the buildings lights are connected and there is a song 🎶 with lyrics displayed on the buildings. it was so lovely to stroll at Talent Park in the evening!

reviews.author: Joe Macpherson
reviews.text: Great park by day or night.  Lots of beautiful buildings and statues.  Perfect for a morning or night walk

query: 石湾酒庄 酒行会馆 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Former wine merchants' guild hall showcasing Shiwan Yubingshao rice wine.
summary.zh: 旧时酒商议事的会馆，展示石湾玉冰烧米酒。

why.en: Shiwan Yubingshao, a rice spirit aged with pork fat, is a Foshan speciality with roots in the Qing dynasty. The restored guild hall shows how the merchants met and traded; ten minutes is enough.
why.zh: 石湾玉冰烧是以肥猪肉浸泡陈酿的米酒，是佛山特产，源自清代。修复后的会馆展示旧时酒商聚会交易的场景，看十分钟就够。

query: 顺记冰室 宝华路 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Decades-old ice-cream parlour on Baohua Road.
summary.zh: 宝华路几十年的老冰室。

why.en: Founded in 1940s Xiguan, it is known for coconut ice cream made with fresh coconut, with real coconut shreds through it. A local treat that has kept the same recipe for generations.
why.zh: 上世纪四十年代在西关开业，招牌椰子雪糕用新鲜椰子做，吃得到椰丝；几代人不变的老味道。

tips.en: Founding date is unconfirmed.
tips.zh: 开业年份凭记忆，可能不准确。

reviews.author: David Liao
reviews.text: Shun Kee Ice Cream Parlor in Guangzhou is a popular and long-established local restaurant. They offer convenient QR code ordering, fast service, and quick, attentive customer service.

reviews.author: Z Z
reviews.text: Shangxiajiu Road was so crowded and the place was huge! I was exhausted from walking around. I found this place to rest. It's an old shop, serving local Guangzhou desserts and snacks—all sorts of things.

aliases: 天星小轮：湾仔 → 尖沙咀
query: Star Ferry Pier, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong

summary.en: Century-old ferry across Victoria Harbour, Tsim Sha Tsui to Central.
summary.zh: 尖沙咀到中环的百年渡轮，横渡维港。

why.en: Operating since the late 19th century, it is one of the cheapest and most memorable harbour crossings anywhere. The ~10 min ride puts the skyline right in front of the kids at water level.
why.zh: 19世纪末开始运营，是全世界最便宜也最难忘的过海方式之一。约10分钟船程，孩子在海面上近看天际线。

reviews.author: Soko 37 (Soko37)
reviews.text: Very easy access to other side of the bay, just 10min in good weather and decent price. Possibility to buy something before boarding. Connection to many bus lines and metro line Tsim Sha Tsui. Very convenient interval for ferry

reviews.author: Lueh-Wai Wong
reviews.text: If you are a tourist, a ferry trip from Tsim Sha Tsui to Hong Kong Island is a must-do event since you haven’t visited Hong Kong without making this ferry trip. The ferry ride is very affordable so no reason to skip.

reviews.author: Tony Doan
reviews.text: Your exploration of this vibrant metropolis is incomplete without crossing Victoria Harbour by boat from the iconic Tsim Sha Tsui docks.

query: Tai Cheong Bakery, 35 Lyndhurst Terrace, Central, Hong Kong

summary.en: Lyndhurst Terrace bakery famous for egg tarts.
summary.zh: 摆花街以蛋挞出名的饼家。

why.en: Its egg tarts became famous after Hong Kong's last governor, Chris Patten, was photographed eating them. Bought warm and eaten while walking to the Peak Tram, which is ~10 min away.
why.zh: 末代港督彭定康被拍到吃这里的蛋挞后名声大噪。趁热买了边走边吃，步行约10分钟到山顶缆车。

en: On the way to the Peak Tram

tips.en: The Central shop is known for shortcrust tarts; the plan's “flaky pastry” description should be checked.
tips.zh: 中环店以牛油曲奇皮蛋挞出名，行程中“酥皮”的描述待核实。

reviews.author: YB (Yogi)
reviews.text: We always find ourselves coming back to Tai Cheong Bakery for their OG cookie crust egg tarts. The crust is perfectly crunchy on the outside, with that slightly crumbly, buttery bite that makes it so addictive.

reviews.author: wjh
reviews.text: I had the normal egg tart and the cookie crust egg tart. The normal egg tart was terrific, it was not overly sweet, and the crust was nicely flakey.

reviews.author: Wandering Pup
reviews.text: I finally got to try the egg tart from Tai Cheong Bakery. It was okay, but honestly, it wasn’t my favorite. I like Bakehouse’s egg tart a lot more. Still, I’m glad I tried it since Tai Cheong is such a well-known spot in HK.

query: 太二酸菜鱼 星河WORLD COCO Park, 坂田, 深圳

summary.en: Popular pickled-cabbage fish chain.
summary.zh: 网红酸菜鱼连锁。

why.en: One dish is done well: boneless fish slices in a sour, gently spicy pickled-cabbage broth, with the pickles cured in-house. Fast service and a short menu suit a mid-tour lunch.
why.zh: 只把一道菜做好：无骨鱼片配酸辣酸菜汤，酸菜自家腌制。上菜快、菜单短，适合行程中的午餐。

tips.en: The chain has historically not seated parties of more than four at one table; a larger family may be split. Branch presence in this mall is unconfirmed.
tips.zh: 这家连锁过去不接待超过4人同桌，人多可能要分桌。该商场是否有分店待确认。

query: 太艮堡毋米粥 Lingnan Tiandi, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Shunde-style congee hotpot, cooked in rice broth with the grains strained out.
summary.zh: 顺德毋米粥火锅：米粒熬化后滤掉，只用米汤做锅底。

why.en: Rice is boiled until it dissolves and the grains are strained out, so only a silky rice broth is left as the hotpot base. Seafood and meat are cooked in it briefly, then the thickened broth is eaten as congee at the end — two courses from one pot, and gentle enough for kids.
why.zh: 米熬到化开后把米粒滤掉，只留顺滑米汤做锅底。海鲜、肉类涮熟先吃，最后锅底变成浓粥再喝，一锅两吃，孩子也合口。

tips.en: Name comes from an older guide; whether this branch is still open should be checked on the day.
tips.zh: 店名来自较早的攻略，到时确认是否仍在营业。

reviews.author: Mae Shao
reviews.text: The rice porridge is a must-try when visiting Foshan. The ingredients are fresh and unique, making it a rare experience for visitors.

reviews.author: alex lee
reviews.text: Food was exceptional. Deco was nice. Service was excellent. Food hygiene was excellent. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: PiPi Lu
reviews.text: Guangzhou has a long tradition of "eating congee for health." Rice-free congee, with its delicate texture where water and rice are perfectly blended and no rice grains are visible, continues the essence of Cantonese congee's pursuit of a smooth

query: Taikoo Hui, 383 Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: High-end Swire mall on Tianhe Road.
summary.zh: 天河路上太古集团的高端商场。

why.en: High-end brands and design-led shops sit alongside some of the best mall restaurants in Tianhe, which suits a proper New Year's Eve dinner. French patisseries inside serve macarons and petits gâteaux for a mid-walk break.
why.zh: 高端品牌和设计感强的店，加上天河区数一数二的商场餐厅，适合跨年吃一顿正式的。里面的法式甜品店有马卡龙、法式小蛋糕，逛累了可以歇一下。

zh: 法式甜品：马卡龙、小蛋糕

tips.en: Restaurants should be booked for New Year's Eve; arrival before 17:30 is advised. The specific patisserie is not named in the plan.
tips.zh: 跨年夜要提前订位，最好17:30前到。行程未指定具体是哪家甜品店。

reviews.author: NOOR MOHAMMAD
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Taikoo Hui Guangzhou. The mall is modern, clean, and beautifully designed, with a luxurious atmosphere. It offers a fantastic selection of international luxury brands, popular fashion stores, and excellent dining options.

reviews.author: Kenny Yap
reviews.text: Fantastic modern mall with plenty of good food options and luxury brands including Songmont. The toilet was probably what impressed me the most.

reviews.author: Droston Tang
reviews.text: I couldn’t find the “Day by Day” on Google Maps at Taikoo Hui. The helpful service crew told us it had only recently opened and had gone wildly popular on social media — no surprise given the crowds!

query: 太平馆 北京路 财厅前 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Founded 1860, China's oldest Western-style restaurant.
summary.zh: 1860年创办，中国最早的西餐厅之一。

why.en: Opened in 1860 by a former cook for foreign merchants, it created “Cantonese-style Western food”. Zhou Enlai held his wedding banquet here. Roast squab and Portuguese chicken are the dishes it is known for, and both are easy wins with children.
why.zh: 1860年由曾为洋商做饭的厨师创办，开创“广式西餐”；周恩来曾在这里办婚宴。烧乳鸽和葡国鸡是招牌，小孩一般都爱吃。

tips.en: The Beijing Road (Caitingqian) branch is the one in the plan.
tips.zh: 行程指的是北京路财厅前的店。

reviews.author: SKYLINE Tien
reviews.text: The first Western restaurant in Guangzhou, the food is above average, and the desserts and ice cream are definitely worth trying.

reviews.author: fang wang
reviews.text: Service ok, still could be improved. Delicious food. Nice location.

query: 陶陶居 第十甫路20号 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Flagship teahouse of a dim sum brand founded in 1880.
summary.zh: 1880年创立的茶楼总店。

why.en: Opened in 1880, it is one of Guangzhou's most famous teahouses; its signboard is said to be written by the reformer Kang Youwei. Dim sum here is the classic Cantonese yum cha experience, steps from Shangxiajiu.
why.zh: 1880年开业，广州最出名的茶楼之一，招牌相传是康有为题写；在这里饮茶是最经典的广式体验，出门就是上下九。

tips.en: Take a queue number on arrival. A per-person tea fee is charged. Kang Youwei attribution is traditional, not verified.
tips.zh: 到了先取号；按人头收茶位费；康有为题字是流传说法，未核实。

aliases: 午餐：陶陶居（正佳广场店）

name.en: Tao Tao Ju, Grandview Mall branch

query: 陶陶居 正佳广场店, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: Branch of the 1880-founded teahouse, on Grandview 6F (unit 6C059).
summary.zh: 创于1880年的老字号茶楼分店，正佳广场六楼6C059号铺。

why.en: Tao Tao Ju has served Cantonese dim sum since 1880 and is one of Guangzhou's most famous teahouse names. This branch gives the same menu without the trip to the old city.
why.zh: 陶陶居1880年起做广式点心，是广州最有名的茶楼老字号之一；这家分店菜单一样，不用回老城。

tips.en: Sunday lunch is busy; call to check the queue: 020-38373301.
tips.zh: 周日午市人多，先打电话问排队：020-38373301。

imageCredit: Wikimedia Commons, Liuxingy, CC BY-SA 4.0 (signature dish, brand photo)

query: Teemall, Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: Long-established mall at the heart of Tianhe Road.
summary.zh: 天河路商圈的老牌商场。

why.en: Opened in the 1990s as one of China's first large modern malls, it anchors the Tianhe Road shopping district. Year-end New Year decorations are put up, and Parc Central is reached directly by an underground passage.
why.zh: 上世纪90年代开业，是国内最早的大型现代商场之一，天河路商圈的核心。年底有新年装饰，地下通道直通天环广场。

reviews.author: Colin Leung
reviews.text: Massive shopping mall. So many floors. Very inviting entrance with bright lights and displays worthy of taking pictures of. Such a lively area. Definitely worth a visit. Can spend all day here!

reviews.author: Hằng
reviews.text: The shopping mall is beautiful. Since the new Minions movie is showing, the whole mall is decorated with Minions. It's super cute.

query: 十三行服装批发市场 十三行路 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Women's-clothing wholesale buildings on the old Thirteen Hongs site.
summary.zh: 清代十三行旧址上的女装批发大楼。

why.en: In the Qing dynasty this was China's only legal foreign-trade district. Today it is a cluster of women's-clothing wholesale towers where new styles arrive weekly; some stalls sell single pieces.
why.zh: 清代这里是全国唯一合法对外通商的地方；现在是女装批发大楼集中地，每周上新款，部分档口零售。

tips.en: Many stalls do not allow photos or trying on. Ask the price first; bargaining is expected.
tips.zh: 很多档口不让拍照、不一定能试穿；先问价，可以讲价。

reviews.author: 周正忠
reviews.text: It's very similar to Wufenpu in Songshan District; the cheap prices will leave you overwhelmed and unsure of what to buy, and everything seems so good—it's terrifying.

reviews.author: Daniel Cheong
reviews.text: Mostly younger fella fashion. Mature adult, don't waste your time here. 98% women apparel. Men apparel goto Shahe Garment Market.

reviews.author: wuan ng
reviews.text: Many shops don't sell individual items. There are lots of clothes, which can be overwhelming.

query: Thirteen Hongs Museum, Xidi, Liwan, Guangzhou

summary.en: Free museum of Qing-era export art from the Canton trade.
summary.zh: 免费的清代十三行外销艺术博物馆。

why.en: Canton enamel porcelain, embroidery, export fans and silverware made for Western buyers show how Guangzhou traded with the world. A dedicated silverware gallery is on the 3rd floor. Free entry.
why.zh: 广彩瓷、广绣、外销扇和银器，都是当年卖给西方的货品，看得出广州怎样和世界做生意；三楼有银器专题展，免费入场。

tips.en: Entry usually stops around 17:00; check before setting off. Kids must be accompanied.
tips.zh: 一般17:00左右停止入场，出发前确认；小孩要有人陪同。

reviews.author: Nathan Chong
reviews.text: Very nice museum that exhibits the trade between China and the world in 1700s. It has 2 floors

reviews.author: Mini Rag
reviews.text: A very unique, free, museam, covering the 13 Hongs time in history. Lots to lead men about the period of massive trde through guangzhou. There are numerrous and atifacts from the period. Upstairs they have furniture.

reviews.author: Julide Ozkan
reviews.text: Amazing museum. The aesthetics are nothing I’ve seen before.

query: Tianhe Sports Center, 299 Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou

summary.en: Stadium complex built for the 1987 National Games, with open lawns and paths in central Tianhe.
summary.zh: 为1987年全运会建的体育场馆群，天河中心难得的大片草地和步道。

why.en: Open green space is rare in the middle of Tianhe's malls, and kids can run freely here. Locals jog, play ball and walk dogs, so it gives a feel for everyday Guangzhou.
why.zh: 天河商圈中间少有的开阔空地，孩子可以放开跑。本地人在这里跑步、打球、遛狗，能看到广州的日常生活。

en: Free to enter the outdoor grounds
zh: 就在正佳广场和天河城之间

tips.en: Some areas may be closed during events.
tips.zh: 有赛事或活动时部分区域可能封闭。

reviews.author: Craig Wright
reviews.text: Brilliant place to run around. Very popular and opens from 5am :-) street table tennis is also very popular.

reviews.author: Zoe Dakin
reviews.text: Lovely stadium. Not a tourist attraction but good for sporting events.

query: Toys R Us Ocean Terminal Harbour City Tsim Sha Tsui

summary.en: Toys"R"Us flagship in Ocean Terminal, Harbour City, next to the Star Ferry pier.
summary.zh: 海港城海运大厦的玩具反斗城旗舰店，紧邻天星码头。

why.en: Toys"R"Us's first Hong Kong store was rebuilt as a flagship for its 40th year, with Pokémon Play Lab, a Tomica Brand Store, and Nintendo, Sanrio and VTech zones. It is a few minutes from the Star Ferry pier, so the kids can each pick a Hong Kong souvenir before the van.
why.zh: 玩具反斗城在香港的第一家店，40周年时改成旗舰店，有Pokémon Play Lab、Tomica专门店，以及Nintendo、Sanrio、VTech专区。离天星码头几分钟路，上车前让孩子各挑一件香港手信。

tips.en: Shop OT G21–24 and G39–42, Ocean Terminal. Hours unconfirmed (~11:00–21:00); check on the day.
tips.zh: 海运大厦OT G21–24及G39–42号铺。营业时间未确认（约11:00–21:00），当天再看。

reviews.author: Angus Stew Pitt
reviews.text: Great collection of toys and you can literally find anything you need from here. The branch is located on the ground floor (G/F) of Ocean Terminal in Harbour City.

reviews.author: Mallika Jamy
reviews.text: My kids were so excited to see Toys R Us as it's their favourite place. Sadly the store in Pune India shut down and now they can't shop in their happy place. I was happy to see different toys which otherwise we don't get to see, I landed

reviews.author: Hungry Paaji
reviews.text: Amazing king size toys r us store at harbour city mall in TST. One gets hands on all the global toy brands and entertainment brands for the kids and teens, bit not just limited to them 😉. Also it has amazing individual experience spots for various brands.

query: Tsim Chai Kee Noodle, 98 Wellington Street, Central, Hong Kong

summary.en: Wellington Street wonton noodle shop with oversized shrimp wontons.
summary.zh: 威灵顿街云吞面店，鲜虾云吞个头大。

why.en: Wontons are packed with whole fresh shrimp and are roughly the size of a ping-pong ball. Service is fast, prices are low, and it has long been recognised by the Michelin guide's affordable listings.
why.zh: 云吞包整只鲜虾，大约乒乓球大小。出餐快、价格低，长期被米其林指南列为平价推荐。

en: Fresh shrimp wonton noodles (鲜虾云吞面)

reviews.author: Pineapple Lover
reviews.text: Chance upon this little restaurant that was recommended by the Michelin Guide for many years, and I can see why! The wonton noodles were really yummy, yet comforting, flavourful, and at a very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Alaa Abdallat
reviews.text: I went with a friend for their famous prawn wonton noodle. It DID NOT DISAPPOINT. Just wow, we loved it, the place has a very nice atmosphere, friendly ladies running the place, the food is prepared fast and in an open kitchen setup

reviews.author: fa1
reviews.text: With friendly service, reasonable prices with no overcharging, and fantastic flavors, it’s truly an enchanting restaurant.

query: The Peak Tower, Victoria Peak, Hong Kong

summary.en: Hong Kong's classic lookout over Victoria Harbour.
summary.zh: 俯瞰维港的香港经典观景点。

why.en: The whole of Victoria Harbour, Kowloon and Hong Kong Island are seen at once from the top. It is the one view most associated with Hong Kong.
why.zh: 从山顶一眼看全维港、九龙和港岛。是最能代表香港的风景。

en: The Peak Tower and Sky Terrace

tips.en: The Sky Terrace 428 viewing deck needs a separate or combo ticket; free viewpoints are nearby.
tips.zh: 凌霄阁摩天台428需单独或套票；附近也有免费观景点。

reviews.author: K Ooi
reviews.text: The Peak Tower is another must-visit spot when exploring Hong Kong. Perched high above the city at Victoria Peak, it offers some of the most spectacular views of Hong Kong Island, Victoria Harbour and the surrounding skyline.

reviews.author: Ayo Cordova
reviews.text: The Peak Tower, Hong Kong I visited The Peak Tower just to stroll around, enjoy the surroundings, and see Hong Kong from a different perspective. One of the highlights was getting to see the city from a bird’s-eye view.

reviews.author: Anthony W Belcher FCA
reviews.text: The final tick on Ros’ list was the trip to the Peak, the highest point in the city where the funicular railway takes you to the summit for panoramic views of this huge city landscape.

query: 惠如楼 中山五路 越秀区 广州

summary.en: Heritage teahouse on Zhongshan 5th Road.
summary.zh: 中山五路老字号茶楼。

why.en: One of Guangzhou's oldest teahouses, dating to the Qing dynasty, still serving traditional dim sum and Cantonese dishes. A Chinese alternative to Taiping Guan, a few minutes away.
why.zh: 广州最老的茶楼之一，可追溯到清代，至今仍做传统点心和粤菜；离太平馆几分钟，想吃中餐就去这里。

tips.en: Founding year not verified.
tips.zh: 创立年份未核实。

reviews.author: Kevin Bites
reviews.text: Huiru Restaurant is a time-honored Cantonese yum cha house in Guangzhou. It serves authentic handmade dim sum. Don’t miss dried flounder siu mai and olive kernel Sachima. Lingnan-style decor, private rooms for groups. Expect queues on weekends.

query: Wanbo CBD, Panyu, Guangzhou

summary.en: Panyu's main mall district, ~15 min by taxi from Chimelong.
summary.zh: 番禺主要商圈，离长隆打车约15分钟。

why.en: The nearest place to Chimelong with ordinary city prices: chain teahouses, Cantonese restaurants and several large malls.
why.zh: 离长隆最近、价格正常的地方：连锁茶楼、粤菜馆，还有几个大型商场。

tips.en: A district, not a single venue; a specific restaurant should be chosen on Dianping before leaving. Specific malls are not verified.
tips.zh: 是一个商圈不是单一地点，出发前在大众点评选好餐厅；具体商场未核实。

query: Wanfu Stage, Foshan Ancestral Temple, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Weekend Cantonese opera on a Qing-dynasty stage inside Foshan Ancestral Temple.
summary.zh: 周末在祖庙清代古戏台万福台上演的粤剧。

why.en: Foshan is regarded as a birthplace of Cantonese opera, and Wanfu Stage, built in the Qing dynasty, is one of the oldest surviving opera stages in Guangdong. Costumes, gilded carvings and live music can be seen up close; half an hour is enough for kids.
why.zh: 佛山被视为粤剧发源地之一，万福台建于清代，是广东现存最古老的戏台之一。戏服、金漆木雕和现场乐队都能近看，孩子看半小时就够。

tips.en: Schedule per the temple notice on the day; re-entry to the temple may need a ticket.
tips.zh: 演出时间以当天公告为准；重新入园可能要门票。

aliases: 万国奥特莱斯商场餐厅
query: 万国奥特莱斯, 江南大道中, 海珠区, 广州

summary.en: Sports-focused outlet mall in Haizhu.
summary.zh: 海珠区以运动品牌为主的奥特莱斯。

why.en: Brands are mostly directly operated, and the Nike and Adidas super-flagship discount stores each exceed six basketball courts in area. Sports shoes, tennis shoes, sportswear and kids' sizes are all covered in one trip.
why.zh: 大多是品牌直营，耐克、阿迪达斯超级旗舰折扣店面积都超过六个标准篮球场。运动鞋、网球鞋、运动服和童装童鞋一次买齐。

en: Nike and Adidas super-flagship discount stores
zh: 耐克、阿迪达斯超级旗舰折扣店

tips.en: Traffic backs up 700–800 m from the mall; it is quicker to get out nearby and walk. Coordinates are approximate.
tips.zh: 商场附近七八百米开始塞车，可提前下车步行。坐标为大致位置。

reviews.author: daddydrives
reviews.text: We wasted no time heading to Wanguo Outlets during our Guangzhou trip to get some outlet shopping off our to-do list. My wife and I ended up spending the day shopping and eating, and by the time we were done, it was already night.

reviews.author: Sean Sean
reviews.text: Branded outlet mall. More of sports brand like addidas, Nike etc. they say it's the cheapest place to buy branded sports shoe in guangzhou.

query: White Swan Hotel, 1 Shamian South Street, Guangzhou

summary.en: Landmark 1983 riverside hotel with a famous lobby garden.
summary.zh: 1983年开业的江边地标酒店，大堂园景有名。

why.en: Opened in 1983 as one of mainland China's first five-star hotels, it has hosted many heads of state. The atrium's “故乡水” (Homeland Waters) rock garden and waterfall can be viewed free of charge, with the Pearl River behind the glass.
why.zh: 1983年开业，是内地最早的五星级酒店之一，接待过多位外国元首；中庭“故乡水”假山瀑布免费参观，玻璃外就是珠江。

reviews.author: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: This hotel was a dream! All around it is photo worthy, then on the inside, a real waterfall with koi fish 🥰 the buffet options are all top-notch, worth the price.

reviews.author: JUAN LIU
reviews.text: I had dim sum at Yu Tang Chun Nuan at the White Swan Hotel during the day, and the overall experience was excellent. The service, in particular, left a lasting impression.

aliases: 白天鹅宾馆 玉堂春暖

name.zh: 白天鹅宾馆 玉堂春暖

query: 玉堂春暖 白天鹅宾馆 沙面 广州

summary.en: The White Swan's Cantonese restaurant, with river-view dim sum.
summary.zh: 白天鹅宾馆的粤菜餐厅，江景点心。

why.en: The hotel's flagship Cantonese restaurant has held a Michelin star in the Guangzhou guide. Refined dim sum is served at window tables over the Pearl River, at the end of the Shamian walk.
why.zh: 宾馆的旗舰粤菜厅，曾获广州米其林一星；临江窗边吃精致点心，正好接在沙面步行之后。

tips.en: Booking recommended. Michelin status is from memory and should be checked for the current year.
tips.zh: 建议预约；米其林星级凭记忆，以当年名单为准。

reviews.author: Jayden Woo
reviews.text: 玉堂春暖 (广州) - Touted as one of the top dimsum eatery in Guangzhou, this multiple times Michelin one star restaurant did not disappoint. It lives up to our expectations for their ambience, food & service.

reviews.author: Terence Tai
reviews.text: It’s a Michelin stars restaurant and black pears rated and it’s certainly matched the standard. Though, expect to pay the premium price for the food and services here.

reviews.author: Martin C
reviews.text: One of the one star Michelin star awarded restaurant in Guangzhou. The restaurant is super popular, we have to wait over 80 tables during a typical Saturday noon time. The food is definitely not cheap, but most dim sum and Cantonese dishes are truly wonderful.

query: 黄振龙凉茶 天河路, 天河区, 广州

summary.en: Classic Guangzhou herbal tea chain.
summary.zh: 广州老字号凉茶连锁。

why.en: Herbal tea is part of everyday Cantonese life, and this is the name locals know best. Bitter 24-herb tea is a rite of passage for adults; kids can try the milder Xia Sang Ju or sweetened herbal jelly.
why.zh: 凉茶是广州人日常生活的一部分，黄振龙是本地人最熟悉的牌子。大人可以挑战苦的廿四味，孩子喝清淡的夏桑菊，或者吃加糖的龟苓膏。

en: Milder Xia Sang Ju for kids

tips.en: Search “黄振龙” in Amap for the branch nearest Tianhe Road; exact branch is unconfirmed and coordinates are approximate.
tips.zh: 在高德搜“黄振龙”找天河路附近的分店；具体分店和坐标为大致位置。

query: Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall, Foshan Ancestral Temple, Chancheng, Foshan

summary.en: Memorial hall to the Foshan-born martial artist and physician Wong Fei-hung, inside the temple grounds.
summary.zh: 纪念佛山武术家、医师黄飞鸿的展馆，在祖庙景区内。

why.en: Wong Fei-hung is the folk hero of dozens of kung fu films, and his real life as a martial artist and doctor is shown here. Kids who have seen the films can match the legend to the man.
why.zh: 黄飞鸿是几十部功夫片的主角，这里展示他作为武师和医生的真实生平。看过电影的孩子可以对照传说和真人。

en: Film stills and kung fu exhibits

reviews.author: KT Lim
reviews.text: Watch 10 am Martial Art display and Lion Dance by Wong Fei Hong Troup. Together with Ip Man _ Grandmaster of Wing Chun and Ancestral Temple of Emperor Huang Di.

reviews.author: Google Lum
reviews.text: Visited in November recently. Another attraction with historical significance. It is a large complex with various displays including about Huang FeiHong and also martial arts and lion dance performance.

reviews.author: 00Y
reviews.text: Really impressed by the architecture and art in this historical building.

query: 香云纱园林酒店, 25 Qinghui Road, Daliang, Shunde, Foshan

summary.en: Long-standing Daliang restaurant next to Qinghui Garden, serving classic Shunde dishes.
summary.zh: 清晖园旁的凤城老字号，做经典顺德菜。

why.en: Classic Shunde home-style dishes are served right beside Qinghui Garden. Fried milk (炒牛奶) — milk and egg white stir-fried into soft curds — was invented in Daliang and is a natural pick for kids.
why.zh: 就在清晖园旁边吃经典顺德菜。炒牛奶是大良发明的菜，牛奶和蛋白炒成嫩滑的块，孩子容易接受。

tips.en: Address: 25 Qinghui Road (清晖路25号).
tips.zh: 地址：清晖路25号。

query: 银记肠粉 文昌北路 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Original shop of Guangzhou's best-known rice-roll brand.
summary.zh: 广州最出名的肠粉老字号本店。

why.en: Rice rolls are steamed on cloth (布拉) here, giving thin, silky sheets wrapped around shrimp or beef. It is a meal kids rarely refuse, open from morning to night, and minutes from Shangxiajiu.
why.zh: 这里是布拉肠粉，粉皮薄滑，包鲜虾或牛肉；小孩很少不爱吃，从早开到晚，离上下九几分钟。

tips.en: The brand has many branches; this entry is the Wenchang North Road shop named in the plan.
tips.zh: 银记分店很多，这里指行程里的文昌北路老店。

reviews.author: Wayne Huang
reviews.text: Yin Kee Rice Noodle Roll Shop was established in 1958 and has been in business for almost 70 years. The walls are adorned with various awards, and it's a must-try rice noodle roll shop recommended by netizens when visiting Guangzhou!

reviews.author: かわお
reviews.text: I had beef rice noodle rolls and boiled lettuce-like vegetables. The rice noodle rolls had a slightly unique taste that I don't think I'd find in Japan, but the boiled vegetables were surprisingly delicious.

query: 永庆食集 永庆坊 荔湾区 广州

summary.en: Food hall of heritage Cantonese snack brands in Yongqingfang.
summary.zh: 永庆坊里的老字号小吃集合。

why.en: Several old-brand snack stalls sit under one roof, so a family can sample beef offal, pan-fried dumplings and Hong Kong-style yuanyang tea in one stop. Portions are small enough to taste before lunch.
why.zh: 几家老字号小吃集中在一起，一站就能试牛杂、煎饺、港式鸳鸯；分量小，午餐前尝一两样刚好。

en: Several heritage brands in one place

tips.en: Stall line-up is from a 2022 guide and may have changed.
tips.zh: 档口资料来自2022年攻略，可能已变动。

aliases: 永庆坊精品店、文创小店
query: Yongqingfang, Enning Road, Liwan, Guangzhou

summary.en: Restored qilou and Xiguan lanes full of creative shops.
summary.zh: 骑楼和西关老屋改造的文创街区。

why.en: Narrow grey-brick lanes of restored Xiguan houses are packed with creative-design shops, handmade crafts and intangible-heritage gifts. Fushang Lane has the PICOCICI global flagship, selling Sanrio, Disney and Chiikawa goods. Snacks, egg tarts and ice cream are all within a few steps.
why.zh: 青砖窄巷里是改造后的西关老屋，开满文创店、手作店、非遗手信店；富上巷有PICOCICI全球旗舰店，卖三丽鸥、迪士尼、Chiikawa周边；小吃、蛋挞、雪糕都在几步之内。

tips.en: PICOCICI details are from summer 2026 reports. Small shops change quickly.
tips.zh: PICOCICI资料来自2026年夏天的报道；小店换得快。

reviews.author: Eric L
reviews.text: Yongqingfang is one of those places that feels like it shouldn’t exist in the middle of a modern metropolis,,a stretch of beautifully preserved qilou arcade buildings and narrow laneways that takes you straight back to old Guangzhou.

reviews.author: 小虫WeiXiang
reviews.text: there is museum inside to learn about 粤剧 history. This place reminds me of malacca city in Malaysia, and also hoi an in Vietnam. But it is a very popular tourism place so be prepared many people. 李小龙故居 also located inside too.

reviews.author: Sakura Stan
reviews.text: Yongqingfang Yongqingfang (永庆坊) is a vibrant cultural and heritage district in Guangzhou that beautifully blends tradition with modern creativity.

query: 云海肴 星河WORLD COCO Park, 坂田, 深圳

summary.en: Yunnan food chain with mild flavours.
summary.zh: 口味温和的云南菜连锁。

why.en: Steam-pot chicken is cooked in a Jianshui clay pot with no added water, so the broth is pure chicken. Wild-mushroom dishes and mild seasoning make it the most kid-friendly choice here.
why.zh: 汽锅鸡用建水紫陶汽锅蒸，不加水，汤全是鸡汁。菌菇菜和温和口味，是这里最适合孩子的选择。

tips.en: Presence in this mall is unconfirmed.
tips.zh: 该商场是否有分店待确认。
